CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_payment_loans(p_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE public."Loans" l SET "Loan Status"='ปิดยอดแล้ว',
    "Close Date"=CASE WHEN coalesce(nullif(current_setting('payment_crud.parents',true),'')::jsonb,'{}') ? p_id
      THEN p."Payment Date" ELSE (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date END,
    "Closed By"=p."Created By", "Ref Closing Payment"=p."Row ID"
  FROM public."Payments" p
  WHERE p."Row ID"=p_id AND l."Loan Status"='ยังไม่ปิดยอด'
    AND l."Row ID" IN (SELECT r."Ref Loans" FROM public."Repayments" r WHERE r."Ref Payment"=p_id)
    AND l."Principal Amount"::numeric <=
      (SELECT coalesce(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric),0) FROM public."Repayments" r WHERE r."Ref Loans"=l."Row ID")
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public."Charges" c WHERE c."Ref Loans"=l."Row ID"
      AND (c."Principal Due" IS NULL OR c."Interest Due" IS NULL OR
        c."Principal Due"::numeric+c."Interest Due"::numeric >
          (SELECT coalesce(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric+r."Interest Paid"::numeric),0)
           FROM public."Repayments" r WHERE r."Ref Charges"=c."Row ID")));

    AND NEW."Ref Closing Payment" IS NULL AND NEW."Loan Status"='ยังไม่ปิดยอด'
    AND (OLD."Ref Closing Payment"=current_setting('payment_crud.id',true) OR EXISTS
     (SELECT 1 FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=OLD."Row ID" AND "Ref Payment"=current_setting('payment_crud.id',true))
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(current_setting('payment_crud.parents',true),'')::jsonb
      ->current_setting('payment_crud.id',true),'[]')) j WHERE j->>'Row ID'=OLD."Row ID"))
    AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['Loan Status','Ref Closing Payment','Close Date','Closed By'])=
        (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['Loan Status','Ref Closing Payment','Close Date','Closed By']) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW."Ref Closing Payment" IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Closing payment is assigned by the payment engine';

    IF pg_trigger_depth()<2 OR OLD."Ref Closing Payment" IS NOT NULL OR OLD."Loan Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'
      OR NEW."Loan Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ปิดยอดแล้ว' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Closing payment is assigned by the payment engine';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_linked_expense_reimbursement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE expense_amount numeric; expense_holder text;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='Cash Ledger' THEN
  IF NEW."Entry Origin"='Manual' AND NEW."Movement Type"='Expense Reimbursement'
   AND nullif(btrim(NEW."Ref Business Expense"),'') IS NOT NULL THEN
   -- A lock alone leaves a stale REPEATABLE READ source writer able to miss
   -- this reimbursement. Version the parent without changing its values.
   -- Row ID is excluded from the source cash trigger's UPDATE column list.
   UPDATE public."Business Expenses" e SET "Row ID"=e."Row ID"
    WHERE e."Row ID"=NEW."Ref Business Expense"
    RETURNING e."Amount"::numeric,e."Ref Paid By Cash Holder"
    INTO expense_amount,expense_holder;
   IF NOT FOUND OR (expense_amount>0 AND expense_holder='ch:tommy') IS NOT TRUE THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Linked reimbursement expense must have been paid by Tommy';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 ELSE
  -- UPDATE already locks this expense. a0_cash_account has derived its holder.
  IF (NEW."Amount",NEW."Ref Paid By Cash Holder") IS DISTINCT FROM
     (OLD."Amount",OLD."Ref Paid By Cash Holder")
   AND (NEW."Amount"::numeric>0 AND NEW."Ref Paid By Cash Holder"='ch:tommy') IS NOT TRUE
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."Cash Ledger" l
    WHERE l."Ref Business Expense"=OLD."Row ID" AND l."Entry Origin"='Manual'
     AND l."Movement Type"='Expense Reimbursement') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Correct linked reimbursement before changing expense away from a positive Tommy-paid expense';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_loan_consistency()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW."Row ID" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Row ID" THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Loan key cannot change'; END IF;
 IF NEW."Ref Borrowers" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Ref Borrowers" AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=OLD."Row ID") THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Loan has receipts for its original borrower; reassign them first'; END IF;
 IF NEW."Ref Borrowers" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Ref Borrowers" AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."Business Expenses"
  WHERE "Ref Related Loan"=OLD."Row ID" AND "Ref Related Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND "Ref Related Borrower" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."Ref Borrowers") THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Related expense borrower must be corrected before moving this loan'; END IF;
 IF NEW."Principal Amount" IS DISTINCT FROM OLD."Principal Amount" AND
  (NEW."Principal Amount"::numeric<=0 OR NEW."Principal Amount" IS NULL OR NEW."Principal Amount"::numeric<
   (SELECT coalesce(sum("Principal Paid"::numeric),0) FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=OLD."Row ID") OR NEW."Principal Amount"::numeric<
   (SELECT coalesce(sum("Principal Due"::numeric),0) FROM public."Charges" WHERE "Ref Loans"=OLD."Row ID")) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Loan principal must cover its posted principal and recorded principal charges'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.partner_pool_share_at_date(p_date date, p_role text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE pool numeric; a numeric; b numeric; unknown_count integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT sum(n),coalesce(sum(n) FILTER(WHERE role='A'),0),coalesce(sum(n) FILTER(WHERE role='B'),0),
   count(*) FILTER(WHERE role IS NULL OR role NOT IN ('A','B'))
 INTO pool,a,b,unknown_count FROM (
 SELECT CASE WHEN c."Transaction Type"='Contribution' THEN c."Amount"::numeric ELSE -c."Amount"::numeric END n,
 p."Partner Role" role FROM public."Cash Pool Contributions" c
 LEFT JOIN public."Partners" p ON p."Row ID"=c."Ref Partner" WHERE c."Contribution Date"<=p_date) s;
 IF p_date IS NULL OR coalesce(pool,0)<=0 OR unknown_count>0 OR a<0 OR b<0 OR p_role NOT IN ('A','B') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Expense allocation requires a positive A/B contribution pool on its allocation date';
 END IF;
 RETURN CASE WHEN p_role='A' THEN a/pool ELSE 1-a/pool END;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.payment_charge_balances(p_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(charge text, loan text, charge_day date, principal numeric, interest numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT c."Row ID",c."Ref Loans",c."Charge Date",
    c."Principal Due"::numeric-paid.p,c."Interest Due"::numeric-paid.i
  FROM public."Payments" p
  JOIN public."Loans" l ON l."Ref Borrowers"=p."Ref Borrower"
  JOIN public."Charges" c ON c."Ref Loans"=l."Row ID"
  LEFT JOIN public."Charges" target ON target."Row ID"=p."Ref Target Charge"
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric),0) p,
           coalesce(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric),0) i
    FROM public."Repayments" r WHERE r."Ref Charges"=c."Row ID"
  ) paid
  WHERE p."Row ID"=p_id AND CASE
    WHEN p."Allocation Method" IN ('Single Full','Single Partial','First-day Auto')
      THEN c."Row ID"=p."Ref Target Charge"
    WHEN p."Allocation Method"='Loan Close' THEN c."Ref Loans"=target."Ref Loans"
    WHEN p."Allocation Method" IN ('Receive All','Lump Sum') THEN c."Charge Date"<=p."Payment Date"
    WHEN p."Allocation Method"='Selected Charges' THEN
      c."Row ID"=ANY(public.selected_charge_ids(p."Selected Charge IDs"))
      AND c."Charge Date"<=p."Payment Date"
    ELSE false END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_daily_analytics_scoped(p_from date, p_to date, p_accounts text[])
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET plan_cache_mode TO 'force_custom_plan'
AS $function$
DECLARE refreshed_days integer;
BEGIN
 IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_from>p_to
    OR p_to>(statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Analytics requires a valid date range ending no later than Bangkok today';
 END IF;
 IF NOT pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(7112026,7) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Analytics refresh is busy; sync and retry';
 END IF;
 -- Missing account snapshots require a full rebuild of account coverage.
 IF p_accounts IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public."Cash Accounts" a CROSS JOIN generate_series(0,p_to-p_from) d
  WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."Cash Account Daily Analytics" s
   WHERE s."Ref Cash Account"=a."Row ID" AND s."Snapshot Date"=p_from+d)
 ) THEN p_accounts:=NULL; END IF;
 -- One statement provides one consistent source snapshot for every requested date.
 -- Model 3 corrects partially paid pending charges. Existing gross/net profit semantics
 -- remain compatible; new per-role inputs retain the governed rounded allocation rules.
 WITH dates AS (
   SELECT p_from+i AS d FROM generate_series(0,p_to-p_from) i
 ), contributions AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c."Contribution Date" AS d,p."Partner Role" AS role,
     CASE WHEN c."Transaction Type"='Contribution' THEN c."Amount"::numeric
       ELSE -c."Amount"::numeric END AS net
   FROM public."Cash Pool Contributions" c
   LEFT JOIN public."Partners" p ON p."Row ID"=c."Ref Partner"
 ), repayment_days AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT "Payment Date" AS d,sum("Principal Paid"::numeric) AS principal,
     sum("Interest Paid"::numeric) AS interest,count(*) AS repayments
   FROM public."Repayments" GROUP BY "Payment Date"
 ), profit_days AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r.d,CASE WHEN c.pool>0 THEN r.interest*coalesce(c.ab,0)/c.pool ELSE 0 END AS profit
   FROM repayment_days r CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT sum(net) AS pool,sum(net) FILTER(WHERE role IN ('A','B')) AS ab
     FROM contributions WHERE d<=r.d
   ) c
 ), charge_payments AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT "Ref Charges" charge,"Payment Date" d,
    sum(coalesce("Principal Paid"::numeric,0)+coalesce("Interest Paid"::numeric,0)) paid
   FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Payment Date"<=p_to GROUP BY 1,2
 ), charge_events AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c."Row ID" charge,c."Charge Date" d,
    coalesce(c."Principal Due"::numeric,0)+coalesce(c."Interest Due"::numeric,0) due,
    coalesce(sum(cp.paid),0) paid
   FROM public."Charges" c LEFT JOIN charge_payments cp
    ON cp.charge=c."Row ID" AND cp.d<=c."Charge Date"
   WHERE p_to-p_from>=3 AND c."Charge Date"<=p_to GROUP BY 1,2,3
   UNION ALL
   SELECT c."Row ID",cp.d,coalesce(c."Principal Due"::numeric,0)+coalesce(c."Interest Due"::numeric,0),cp.paid
   FROM public."Charges" c JOIN charge_payments cp ON cp.charge=c."Row ID" AND cp.d>c."Charge Date"
   WHERE p_to-p_from>=3 AND c."Charge Date"<=p_to
 ), charge_positions AS (
   SELECT charge,d,greatest(due-sum(paid) OVER(PARTITION BY charge ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING),0) pending
   FROM charge_events
 ), pending_changes AS (
   SELECT d,pending-coalesce(lag(pending) OVER(PARTITION BY charge ORDER BY d),0) delta FROM charge_positions
 ), pending_days AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT d,sum(delta) delta FROM pending_changes GROUP BY d
 ), expenses AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT "Expense Date" d,sum("Amount"::numeric) expense FROM public."Business Expenses" GROUP BY 1
 ), partner_income AS MATERIALIZED (
   -- Keep the governed per-repayment rounded allocation, but filter its inputs
   -- before aggregation instead of evaluating the all-history running report.
   SELECT dates.d,coalesce(i.pa,0)-coalesce(e.pa,0) pa,coalesce(i.pb,0)-coalesce(e.pb,0) pb
   FROM dates LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "Payment Date" d,sum("Partner A Profit") pa,sum("Partner B Profit") pb
    FROM public.olap_repayments_analytics WHERE "Payment Date" BETWEEN p_from AND p_to GROUP BY 1
   ) i USING(d) LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT "Expense Date" d,sum("Partner A Expense"::numeric) pa,sum("Partner B Expense"::numeric) pb
    FROM public."Business Expenses" WHERE "Expense Date" BETWEEN p_from AND p_to GROUP BY 1
   ) e USING(d)
 ), settlements AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT s."Transfer Date" d,sum(s."Amount"::numeric) amount,
    coalesce(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER(WHERE p."Partner Role"='A'),0) pa,
    coalesce(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER(WHERE p."Partner Role"='B'),0) pb
   FROM public."Settlements" s LEFT JOIN public."Partners" p ON p."Row ID"=s."Ref Partner"
   WHERE s."Status"='Completed' AND s."Transfer Date"<=p_to GROUP BY 1
 ), ledger AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT "Movement Date" d,"Ref From Cash Account" from_account,"Ref To Cash Account" to_account,"Amount" amount
   FROM public."Cash Ledger" WHERE "Movement Date"<=p_to
 ), account_flows AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT account,d,sum(greatest(signed,0)) cash_in,sum(greatest(-signed,0)) cash_out,count(*) n
   FROM ledger CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (from_account,-amount),(to_account,amount)) v(account,signed)
   WHERE account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2
 ), consolidated_flows AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT d,sum(greatest(signed,0)) cash_in,sum(greatest(-signed,0)) cash_out
   FROM (SELECT d,(CASE WHEN to_account IS NOT NULL THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
    -(CASE WHEN from_account IS NOT NULL THEN amount ELSE 0 END) signed FROM ledger) v GROUP BY 1
 ), account_seed AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT a."Row ID" account,(c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok')::date available,
    c."Opening Balance"-c."Baseline Cash In"+c."Baseline Cash Out"
     +coalesce(sum(f.cash_in-f.cash_out),0) opening
   FROM public."Cash Accounts" a LEFT JOIN public.r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account"=a."Row ID"
   LEFT JOIN account_flows f ON f.account=a."Row ID" AND f.d<p_from
   WHERE p_accounts IS NULL OR a."Row ID"=ANY(p_accounts)
   GROUP BY a."Row ID",c."Cutover At",c."Opening Balance",c."Baseline Cash In",c."Baseline Cash Out"
 ), account_grid AS (
   SELECT a.*,d.d,coalesce(f.cash_in,0) cash_in,coalesce(f.cash_out,0) cash_out,coalesce(f.n,0) n
   FROM account_seed a CROSS JOIN dates d LEFT JOIN account_flows f ON f.account=a.account AND f.d=d.d
 ), account_positions AS (
   SELECT *,CASE WHEN d>=available THEN opening+sum(cash_in-cash_out) OVER
    (PARTITION BY account ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) END closing FROM account_grid
 ), computed_accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT jsonb_build_array(account,d)::text AS "Row ID",d AS "Snapshot Date",account AS "Ref Cash Account",statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok' AS "Generated At",3 AS "Model Version",
    cash_in AS "Money In",cash_out AS "Money Out",closing-cash_in+cash_out AS "Opening Balance",closing AS "Closing Balance",n AS "Transaction Count",available AS "Available From",
    CASE WHEN available IS NULL THEN 'Opening not initialized' WHEN d<available THEN 'Before known opening' ELSE 'Available' END AS "Balance Status"
   FROM account_positions
 ), saved_accounts AS (
   INSERT INTO public."Cash Account Daily Analytics"("Row ID","Snapshot Date","Ref Cash Account","Generated At","Model Version","Money In","Money Out","Opening Balance","Closing Balance","Transaction Count","Available From","Balance Status")
   SELECT * FROM computed_accounts
   ON CONFLICT ("Snapshot Date","Ref Cash Account") DO UPDATE SET
    "Generated At"=EXCLUDED."Generated At","Model Version"=EXCLUDED."Model Version",
    "Money In"=EXCLUDED."Money In","Money Out"=EXCLUDED."Money Out",
    "Opening Balance"=EXCLUDED."Opening Balance","Closing Balance"=EXCLUDED."Closing Balance",
    "Transaction Count"=EXCLUDED."Transaction Count","Available From"=EXCLUDED."Available From","Balance Status"=EXCLUDED."Balance Status"
   WHERE p_accounts IS NULL OR
    (to_jsonb("Cash Account Daily Analytics")-'Generated At') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(EXCLUDED)-'Generated At')
   RETURNING *
 ), all_accounts AS (
   SELECT * FROM computed_accounts
   UNION ALL
   SELECT "Row ID","Snapshot Date","Ref Cash Account","Generated At","Model Version","Money In","Money Out","Opening Balance","Closing Balance","Transaction Count","Available From","Balance Status" FROM public."Cash Account Daily Analytics"
   WHERE p_accounts IS NOT NULL AND NOT ("Ref Cash Account"=ANY(p_accounts)) AND "Snapshot Date" BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
 ), cash_positions AS (
   SELECT "Snapshot Date" d,
    CASE WHEN bool_and("Closing Balance" IS NOT NULL) THEN sum("Closing Balance") END closing,
    CASE WHEN bool_and("Opening Balance" IS NOT NULL) THEN sum("Opening Balance") END opening,
    CASE WHEN bool_and("Available From" IS NOT NULL) THEN max("Available From") END available,
    CASE WHEN bool_and("Closing Balance" IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Available'
     WHEN bool_and("Available From" IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Before known opening' ELSE 'Opening not initialized' END status
   FROM all_accounts GROUP BY 1
 ), metrics AS (
   SELECT dates.d,l.issued,l.loans,l.issued_eod,l.active,l.borrowers,
     r.principal,r.interest,r.repayments,r.returned_eod,c.pending,p.pool,
     coalesce((SELECT sum(profit) FROM profit_days WHERE d<=dates.d),0)
       -coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount"::numeric) FROM public."Settlements"
          WHERE "Status"='Completed' AND "Transfer Date"<=dates.d),0) AS unsettled
   FROM dates
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT coalesce(sum("Principal Amount"::numeric) FILTER(WHERE "Loan Date"=dates.d),0) AS issued,
       count(*) FILTER(WHERE "Loan Date"=dates.d) AS loans,
       coalesce(sum("Principal Amount"::numeric),0) AS issued_eod,
       count(*) FILTER(WHERE "Close Date" IS NULL OR "Close Date">dates.d) AS active,
       count(DISTINCT coalesce("Ref Borrowers",'')) FILTER(WHERE "Close Date" IS NULL OR "Close Date">dates.d) AS borrowers
     FROM public."Loans" WHERE "Loan Date"<=dates.d
   ) l
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
     SELECT coalesce(sum(principal) FILTER(WHERE d=dates.d),0) AS principal,
       coalesce(sum(interest) FILTER(WHERE d=dates.d),0) AS interest,
       coalesce(sum(repayments) FILTER(WHERE d=dates.d),0) AS repayments,
       coalesce(sum(principal),0) AS returned_eod
     FROM repayment_days WHERE d<=dates.d
   ) r
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT coalesce(sum(delta),0) pending FROM pending_days WHERE d<=dates.d HAVING p_to-p_from>=3
    UNION ALL
    SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(coalesce(c."Principal Due"::numeric,0)+coalesce(c."Interest Due"::numeric,0)-coalesce(cp.paid,0),0)),0)
    FROM public."Charges" c LEFT JOIN (SELECT charge,sum(paid) paid FROM charge_payments WHERE d<=dates.d GROUP BY charge) cp
     ON cp.charge=c."Row ID" WHERE c."Charge Date"<=dates.d HAVING p_to-p_from<3
   ) c
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(sum(net),0) AS pool FROM contributions WHERE d<=dates.d) p
 )
 INSERT INTO public."Daily Analytics"("Row ID","Snapshot Date","Generated At","Model Version",
   "Principal Issued","Loans Issued","Principal Returned","Interest Received","Repayments Count",
   "Outstanding Principal EOD","Active Loans EOD","Active Borrowers EOD","Pending Charges EOD",
   "Total Cash Pool EOD","Available Cash EOD","Unsettled Profit EOD","Business Expenses","Net Profit","Net Unsettled Profit EOD",
   "Capital Contributed","Capital Withdrawn","Partner Settlements","Partner A Net Profit","Partner B Net Profit","Partner A Settlements","Partner B Settlements","Cash Money In","Cash Money Out","Cash Opening Balance","Cash Balance EOD","Cash Available From","Cash Balance Status")
 SELECT 'da11:'||metrics.d::text,metrics.d,statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok',3,
   issued::money,loans::integer,principal::money,interest::money,repayments::integer,
   (issued_eod-returned_eod)::money,active::integer,borrowers::integer,pending::money,
   pool::money,(pool+returned_eod-issued_eod)::money,unsettled::money,
   coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount") FROM public."Business Expenses" WHERE "Expense Date"=metrics.d),0::money),
   interest::money-coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount") FROM public."Business Expenses" WHERE "Expense Date"=metrics.d),0::money),
   unsettled::money-coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount") FROM public."Business Expenses" WHERE "Expense Date"<=metrics.d),0::money)
 ,coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount"::numeric) FROM public."Cash Pool Contributions" WHERE "Contribution Date"=metrics.d AND "Transaction Type"='Contribution'),0)
 ,coalesce((SELECT sum("Amount"::numeric) FROM public."Cash Pool Contributions" WHERE "Contribution Date"=metrics.d AND "Transaction Type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Contribution'),0)
 ,coalesce(s.amount,0),coalesce(pi.pa,0),coalesce(pi.pb,0),coalesce(s.pa,0),coalesce(s.pb,0)
 ,coalesce(cf.cash_in,0),coalesce(cf.cash_out,0),cp.opening,cp.closing,cp.available,coalesce(cp.status,'Opening not initialized')
 FROM metrics LEFT JOIN settlements s ON s.d=metrics.d LEFT JOIN partner_income pi ON pi.d=metrics.d
 LEFT JOIN consolidated_flows cf ON cf.d=metrics.d LEFT JOIN cash_positions cp ON cp.d=metrics.d
 ORDER BY metrics.d
 ON CONFLICT ("Snapshot Date") DO UPDATE SET
   "Generated At"=EXCLUDED."Generated At","Model Version"=EXCLUDED."Model Version",
   "Principal Issued"=EXCLUDED."Principal Issued","Loans Issued"=EXCLUDED."Loans Issued",
   "Principal Returned"=EXCLUDED."Principal Returned","Interest Received"=EXCLUDED."Interest Received",
   "Repayments Count"=EXCLUDED."Repayments Count","Outstanding Principal EOD"=EXCLUDED."Outstanding Principal EOD",
   "Active Loans EOD"=EXCLUDED."Active Loans EOD","Active Borrowers EOD"=EXCLUDED."Active Borrowers EOD",
   "Pending Charges EOD"=EXCLUDED."Pending Charges EOD","Total Cash Pool EOD"=EXCLUDED."Total Cash Pool EOD",
   "Available Cash EOD"=EXCLUDED."Available Cash EOD","Unsettled Profit EOD"=EXCLUDED."Unsettled Profit EOD",
   "Business Expenses"=EXCLUDED."Business Expenses","Net Profit"=EXCLUDED."Net Profit",
   "Net Unsettled Profit EOD"=EXCLUDED."Net Unsettled Profit EOD",
   "Capital Contributed"=EXCLUDED."Capital Contributed",
   "Capital Withdrawn"=EXCLUDED."Capital Withdrawn",
   "Partner Settlements"=EXCLUDED."Partner Settlements",
   "Partner A Net Profit"=EXCLUDED."Partner A Net Profit",
   "Partner B Net Profit"=EXCLUDED."Partner B Net Profit",
   "Partner A Settlements"=EXCLUDED."Partner A Settlements",
   "Partner B Settlements"=EXCLUDED."Partner B Settlements",
   "Cash Money In"=EXCLUDED."Cash Money In",
   "Cash Money Out"=EXCLUDED."Cash Money Out",
   "Cash Opening Balance"=EXCLUDED."Cash Opening Balance",
   "Cash Balance EOD"=EXCLUDED."Cash Balance EOD",
   "Cash Available From"=EXCLUDED."Cash Available From",
   "Cash Balance Status"=EXCLUDED."Cash Balance Status"
 WHERE p_accounts IS NULL OR
  (to_jsonb("Daily Analytics")-'Generated At') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(EXCLUDED)-'Generated At');
 GET DIAGNOSTICS refreshed_days=ROW_COUNT;
 RETURN refreshed_days;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_borrower_values(p_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(interest numeric, principal numeric, n integer, outstanding numeric, active_interest numeric, daily numeric, closed boolean, active boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(sum(r.i),0),coalesce(sum(l."Principal Amount"::numeric),0),count(*)::integer,
  coalesce(sum(coalesce(l."Principal Amount"::numeric,0)-coalesce(r.p,0)),0),
  coalesce(sum(r.i) FILTER(WHERE l."Loan Status"='ยังไม่ปิดยอด'),0),
  coalesce(sum(public.vc_daily_interest(l)),0),
  coalesce(bool_or(l."Loan Status"='ปิดยอดแล้ว'),false),coalesce(bool_or(l."Loan Status"='ยังไม่ปิดยอด'),false)
 FROM public."Loans" l LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum("Interest Paid"::numeric) i,sum("Principal Paid"::numeric) p
  FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=l."Row ID"
 ) r ON true WHERE l."Ref Borrowers"=p_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_charge_values(p "Charges")
 RETURNS TABLE(pp numeric, ip numeric, total numeric, pr numeric, ir numeric, remaining numeric, n integer, status text, paid_date date)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 WITH a AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric),0) pp,
   coalesce(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric),0) ip,count(*)::integer n,max(r."Payment Date") d
  FROM public."Repayments" r WHERE r."Ref Charges"=p."Row ID"
 ), b AS (
  SELECT a.*,coalesce(p."Principal Due"::numeric,0)-pp pr,
   coalesce(p."Interest Due"::numeric,0)-ip ir FROM a
 ), c AS (
  SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN (SELECT l."Loan Status" FROM public."Loans" l WHERE l."Row ID"=p."Ref Loans")='ปิดยอดแล้ว'
   THEN 'ชำระแล้ว' WHEN pp+ip=0 THEN 'รอชำระ' WHEN pr+ir>0 THEN 'ชำระบางส่วน' ELSE 'ชำระแล้ว' END s FROM b
 ) SELECT pp,ip,pp+ip,pr,ir,pr+ir,n,s,CASE WHEN s='ชำระแล้ว' THEN d END FROM c;
$function$

functions.name: vc_daily_interest
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_daily_interest(p "Loans")
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN p."Auto Charge Enabled" IS TRUE AND p."Loan Status"='ยังไม่ปิดยอด' THEN
  CASE WHEN p."Loan Type"='ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน' THEN coalesce(p."Current Daily Interest"::numeric,0)
   WHEN p."Loan Type"='ผ่อนชำระรายวัน' AND p."Loan Date" IS NOT NULL AND p."Due Date">=p."Loan Date" AND p."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric>0
   THEN (p."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric*(p."Due Date"-p."Loan Date"+1)-coalesce(p."Principal Amount"::numeric,0))/(p."Due Date"-p."Loan Date"+1)
   ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_loan_row()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 SELECT coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric),0),coalesce(sum("Principal Paid"::numeric),0),
  coalesce(sum(coalesce("Principal Paid"::numeric,0)+coalesce("Interest Paid"::numeric,0)),0)
 INTO NEW."Total Interest Received",NEW."Total Principal Received",NEW."Total Amount Received"
 FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=NEW."Row ID";
 NEW."Outstanding Principal":=coalesce(NEW."Principal Amount"::numeric,0)-NEW."Total Principal Received";
 NEW:=public.apply_principal_daily_interest(NEW,CASE WHEN TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN OLD ELSE NULL::public."Loans" END);
 -- zz_vc_daily_interest precedes this trigger. Refresh its result after adjusting
 -- principal/daily amount so downstream borrower rollups read the same state.
 NEW."Expected Daily Interest Amount":=public.vc_daily_interest(NEW);
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_lock_daily_parent()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF ROW(OLD."Auto Charge Enabled",OLD."Loan Type",OLD."Loan Date",OLD."Due Date",OLD."Current Daily Interest",OLD."Daily Payment Amount")
 IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW."Auto Charge Enabled",NEW."Loan Type",NEW."Loan Date",NEW."Due Date",NEW."Current Daily Interest",NEW."Daily Payment Amount") THEN
  BEGIN PERFORM 1 FROM public."Borrowers" WHERE "Row ID" IN(OLD."Ref Borrowers",NEW."Ref Borrowers") ORDER BY "Row ID" FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;
  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Borrower is busy; sync and retry'; END;
 END IF; RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 WHERE c."Row ID"=v."Row ID" AND
 ROW(c."Principal Paid",c."Interest Paid",c."Total Paid",c."Principal Remaining",c."Interest Remaining",c."Amount Remaining",c."Payment Count",c."Payment Status",c."Payment Date")
 IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(v.pp,v.ip,v.total,v.pr,v.ir,v.remaining,v.n,v.status,v.paid_date);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vc_refresh_loan(p_id text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF pg_trigger_depth()>=2 AND p_id=nullif(current_setting('business_crud.default',true),'') THEN RETURN; END IF;
 UPDATE public."Loans" l SET "Total Interest Received"=v.i,"Total Principal Received"=v.p,
  "Total Amount Received"=v.a,"Outstanding Principal"=coalesce(l."Principal Amount"::numeric,0)-v.p
 FROM (SELECT coalesce(sum("Interest Paid"::numeric),0) i,coalesce(sum("Principal Paid"::numeric),0) p,
  coalesce(sum(coalesce("Principal Paid"::numeric,0)+coalesce("Interest Paid"::numeric,0)),0) a
  FROM public."Repayments" WHERE "Ref Loans"=p_id) v
 WHERE l."Row ID"=p_id AND ROW(l."Total Interest Received",l."Total Principal Received",l."Total Amount Received",l."Outstanding Principal")
 IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(v.i,v.p,v.a,coalesce(l."Principal Amount"::numeric,0)-v.p);
END $function$

        UNION ALL
         SELECT "Cash Ledger"."Ref From Cash Account",
            0::numeric AS "numeric",
            "Cash Ledger"."Amount"
           FROM "Cash Ledger"
          WHERE "Cash Ledger"."Ref From Cash Account" IS NOT NULL
        ), totals AS (
         SELECT flows.account,
            sum(flows.cash_in) AS cash_in,
            sum(flows.cash_out) AS cash_out
           FROM flows
          GROUP BY flows.account
        ), balances AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID" AS "Ref Cash Account",
            a."Ref Cash Holder",
            h."Holder Name",
            a."Account Label",
            c."Opening Balance",
            COALESCE(t.cash_in, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(c."Baseline Cash In", 0::numeric) AS "Cash In",
            COALESCE(t.cash_out, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(c."Baseline Cash Out", 0::numeric) AS "Cash Out",
            c."Opening Balance" + COALESCE(t.cash_in, 0::numeric) - c."Baseline Cash In" - COALESCE(t.cash_out, 0::numeric) + c."Baseline Cash Out" AS "Current Balance",
            c."Ref Cash Account" IS NOT NULL AS "Initialized"
           FROM "Cash Accounts" a
             JOIN "Cash Holders" h ON h."Row ID" = a."Ref Cash Holder"
             LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.account = a."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account" = a."Row ID"
        )
 SELECT "Ref Cash Account",
    "Ref Cash Holder",
    "Holder Name",
    "Account Label",
    "Opening Balance",
    "Cash In",
    "Cash Out",
    "Current Balance",
    "Initialized",
        CASE
            WHEN "Initialized" THEN GREATEST("Current Balance", 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Business Cash Held",
        CASE
            WHEN "Initialized" THEN GREATEST(- "Current Balance", 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Reimbursement / Advance Due"
   FROM balances;

relations.name: Cash Account Daily Summary Recent
relations.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS today
        ), days AS (
         SELECT bounds.today - i.i AS day
           FROM bounds
             CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 14) i(i)
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT cash_statement_account_effects."Ref Cash Account" AS account,
            cash_statement_account_effects."Statement Date" AS day,
            sum(GREATEST(cash_statement_account_effects."Signed Amount", 0::numeric)) AS cash_in,
            sum(GREATEST(- cash_statement_account_effects."Signed Amount", 0::numeric)) AS cash_out,
            count(*) AS n
           FROM cash_statement_account_effects
          GROUP BY cash_statement_account_effects."Ref Cash Account", cash_statement_account_effects."Statement Date"
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID" AS account,
            d.day,
            c."Ref Cash Account" IS NOT NULL AS initialized,
            c."Opening Balance" - c."Baseline Cash In" + c."Baseline Cash Out" + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(x.cash_in - x.cash_out) AS sum
                   FROM daily x
                  WHERE x.account = a."Row ID" AND x.day < d.day), 0::numeric) AS opening,
            COALESCE(t.cash_in, 0::numeric) AS cash_in,
            COALESCE(t.cash_out, 0::numeric) AS cash_out,
            COALESCE(t.n, 0::bigint) AS n
           FROM "Cash Accounts" a
             CROSS JOIN days d
             LEFT JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account" = a."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN daily t ON t.account = a."Row ID" AND t.day = d.day
        )
 SELECT jsonb_build_array(account, day)::text AS "Row ID",
    account AS "Ref Cash Account",
    day AS "Statement Date",
    opening AS "Opening Balance",
    cash_in AS "Money In",
    cash_out AS "Money Out",
    cash_in - cash_out AS "Net Movement",
    opening + cash_in - cash_out AS "Closing Balance",
    n AS "Transaction Count",
    initialized AS "Is Initialized"
   FROM grid;

relations.name: Cash Dashboard
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), profit AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS income,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner A Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_a,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner B Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_b,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner A Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_a,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Partner B Profit") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_b
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d
        ), expense AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(e."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS amount,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner A Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_a,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner B Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" < ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS prior_b,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner A Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_a,
            COALESCE(sum(e."Partner B Expense"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE e."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms), 0::numeric) AS month_b
           FROM "Business Expenses" e
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE e."Expense Date" <= ctx.d
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'A'::text), 0::numeric) AS a,
            COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'B'::text), 0::numeric) AS b
           FROM "Settlements" s
             JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE s."Status" = 'Completed'::text AND s."Transfer Date" <= ctx.d
        ), allocated AS (
         SELECT profit.income,
            expense.amount,
            fifo_current_month_settled(profit.prior_a - expense.prior_a, profit.month_a - expense.month_a, settled.a) AS a,
            fifo_current_month_settled(profit.prior_b - expense.prior_b, profit.month_b - expense.month_b, settled.b) AS b
           FROM profit
             CROSS JOIN expense
             CROSS JOIN settled
        ), cash AS (
         SELECT
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and("Cash Account Balances"."Initialized") THEN sum("Cash Account Balances"."Business Cash Held")
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS held
           FROM "Cash Account Balances"
        )
 SELECT 'cash-dashboard'::text AS "Row ID",
    allocated.income AS "Operating Income MTD",
    - allocated.amount AS "Expenses MTD",
    allocated.income - allocated.amount AS "Net Profit MTD",
    - allocated.a AS "Tommy Withdrawn MTD",
    - allocated.b AS "Lisa Withdrawn MTD",
    allocated.income - allocated.amount - allocated.a - allocated.b AS "Unsettled Profit MTD",
    pool."Available Cashpool"::numeric AS "Cash Pool Remaining",
    cash.held AS "Business Cash Held"
   FROM allocated
     CROSS JOIN "Loan Form Context" pool
     CROSS JOIN cash;

WITH capital AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN p."Partner Role" = 'A'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                        ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                    END
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS a,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN p."Partner Role" = 'B'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                        ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                    END
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS b
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions" c
             LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = c."Ref Partner"
        ), principal AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(l."Principal Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) AS sum
                   FROM "Repayments" r
                     JOIN "Loans" x ON x."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"), 0::numeric) AS outstanding
           FROM "Loans" l
        )
 SELECT 'cashpool'::text AS "Row ID",
    capital.total::money AS "Contributed Capital",
    principal.outstanding::money AS "Outstanding Principal",
    (capital.total - principal.outstanding)::money AS "Available Cashpool",
        CASE
            WHEN capital.total > 0::numeric THEN capital.a / capital.total
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS "Partner A Profit Share",
        CASE
            WHEN capital.total > 0::numeric THEN capital.b / capital.total
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS "Partner B Profit Share"
   FROM capital
     CROSS JOIN principal;

relations.name: cash_statement_account_effects
relations.definition:
SELECT jsonb_build_array(l."Row ID", s.direction, s.account)::text AS "Row ID",
    l."Row ID" AS ledger_id,
    s.direction,
    s.account AS "Ref Cash Account",
    l."Movement Date" AS "Statement Date",
    l."Created At" AS "Sort Timestamp",
    l."Created At"::time without time zone AS "Statement Time",
    s.amount AS "Signed Amount",
        CASE l."Movement Type"
            WHEN 'Payment Receipt'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN p."Allocation Method" = 'First-day Auto'::text THEN 'FIRST_DAY_PAYMENT'::text
                ELSE 'LOAN_PAYMENT'::text
            END
            WHEN 'Loan Disbursement'::text THEN 'LOAN_DISBURSEMENT'::text
            WHEN 'Business Expense'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN e."Source Type" = 'Referral Rebate'::text THEN 'REFERRAL_REBATE'::text
                ELSE 'BUSINESS_EXPENSE'::text
            END
            WHEN 'Partner Settlement'::text THEN 'PARTNER_SETTLEMENT'::text
            WHEN 'Cash Handover'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN fa."Ref Cash Holder" = ta."Ref Cash Holder" THEN 'ACCOUNT_TRANSFER'::text
                ELSE 'CASH_TRANSFER'::text
            END
            WHEN 'Expense Reimbursement'::text THEN 'EXPENSE_REIMBURSEMENT'::text
            WHEN 'Opening Balance'::text THEN 'OPENING_BALANCE'::text
            WHEN 'Manual Correction'::text THEN 'MANUAL_CORRECTION'::text
            ELSE 'OTHER'::text
        END AS "Transaction Type Code",
        CASE
            WHEN l."Movement Type" = ANY (ARRAY['Cash Handover'::text, 'Expense Reimbursement'::text]) THEN 'ACCOUNT'::text
            WHEN l."Movement Type" = 'Manual Correction'::text THEN 'ADJUSTMENT'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(p."Ref Borrower", n."Ref Borrowers", e."Ref Payee Borrower") IS NOT NULL THEN 'BORROWER'::text
            WHEN st."Ref Partner" IS NOT NULL THEN 'PARTNER'::text
            WHEN e."Row ID" IS NOT NULL THEN 'PAYEE'::text
            ELSE 'NONE'::text
        END AS "Counterparty Kind",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(e."Payee Name", ''::text), NULLIF(e."Expense Category", ''::text), ''::text) AS "Counterparty Text",
    COALESCE(p."Ref Borrower", n."Ref Borrowers", e."Ref Payee Borrower") AS "Ref Borrower",
    s.other_account AS "Ref Other Cash Account",
    st."Ref Partner",
    l."Ref Payment",
    l."Ref Loan",
    l."Ref Business Expense",
    l."Ref Settlement" AS "Settlement Row ID",
    l."Notes",
    l."Source Type",
    l."Source Key"
   FROM "Cash Ledger" l
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('OUT'::text,l."Ref From Cash Account",- l."Amount",l."Ref To Cash Account"), ('IN'::text,l."Ref To Cash Account",l."Amount",l."Ref From Cash Account")) s(direction, account, amount, other_account)
     LEFT JOIN "Payments" p ON p."Row ID" = l."Ref Payment"
     LEFT JOIN "Loans" n ON n."Row ID" = l."Ref Loan"
     LEFT JOIN "Business Expenses" e ON e."Row ID" = l."Ref Business Expense"
     LEFT JOIN "Settlements" st ON st."Row ID" = l."Ref Settlement"
     LEFT JOIN "Cash Accounts" fa ON fa."Row ID" = l."Ref From Cash Account"
     LEFT JOIN "Cash Accounts" ta ON ta."Row ID" = l."Ref To Cash Account"
  WHERE s.account IS NOT NULL;

    old_view."Matrix Current Condition Score",
    old_view."Matrix History Sufficient",
    old_view."Matrix Stability Score",
    old_view."Matrix Quadrant",
    old_view."Profit Last 10 Days",
    old_view."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
    old_view."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
    b."Ref Preferred Receiving Cash Account",
    b."Payment Request Cash Account",
    b."Payment Request Token"
   FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                 SELECT q.d,
                    date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
                    (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
                   FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
                ), lr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS active,
                    max(l."Loan Age Days") FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS oldest,
                    GREATEST(0::numeric, max(l."Principal Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text AND l."Defaulted" = false)) AS largest,
                    COALESCE(avg(l."Principal Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text AND l."Defaulted" = false), 0::numeric) AS average_success,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted" = true) AS defaults,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."Default Loss Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted" = true), 0::numeric) AS loss,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."30D Principal Days"), 0::numeric) AS gross_days,
                    COALESCE(sum(l."Expected Interest This Month"), 0::numeric) AS forecast,
                    bool_or(l."Defaulted" = true AND l."Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric) AS current_default
                   FROM olap_loans_analytics l
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), rr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= (ctx.d - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d AND r."Interest Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit30,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= (ctx.d - 10) AND r."Payment Date" < ctx.d AND r."Interest Paid"::numeric > 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit10,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND r."Payment Date" <= ctx.me), 0::numeric) AS mtd,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."30D Principal Reduction Days"), 0::numeric) AS reduction
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
                     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), cash AS (
                 SELECT c."Ref Collection Borrower" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(r."Amount Received"), 0::numeric) AS collected
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
                     JOIN olap_charges_analytics c ON c."Row ID" = r."Ref Charges"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  WHERE r."Payment Date" = ctx.d AND c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY c."Ref Collection Borrower"
                ), cr AS (
                 SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS id,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text), 0::numeric) AS overdue,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS overdue_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Historical On Time") AS ontime,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS recent_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical On Time") AS recent_ontime,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Historical Late") AS late_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 30) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical Late") AS recent_late,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late")) AS max_late,
                    max(c."Charge Date") FILTER (WHERE c."Days Late" > 0) AS last_late,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 180) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history180,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 180) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Historical On Time") AS ontime180,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS history90,
                    bool_or(l."Defaulted") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS default90,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d)) AS late90,
                    GREATEST(0, max(c."Days Late") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric)) AS unpaid_late,
                    bool_or(c."Total Paid" > 0::numeric) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" = ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric) AS partial_today,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" = ctx.d AND c."Amount Remaining" > 0::numeric) AS unpaid_today,
                    min(c."Charge Date") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" < ctx.d) AS first_history,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL) AS collection_count,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS collection_overdue,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'รอชำระ'::text) AS collection_pending,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระบางส่วน'::text) AS collection_partial,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระแล้ว'::text) AS collection_paid,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Due") FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS collection_due,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Ref Collection Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS collection_remaining,
                    COALESCE(sum(c."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS interest_remaining
                   FROM olap_charges_analytics c
                     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
                ), er AS (
                 SELECT "Business Expenses"."Ref Payee Borrower" AS id,
                    sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) AS rebate
                   FROM "Business Expenses"
                  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Source Type" = 'Referral Rebate'::text
                  GROUP BY "Business Expenses"."Ref Payee Borrower"
                ), pt AS (
                 SELECT COALESCE(sum("Loans"."Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS portfolio
                   FROM "Loans"
                ), bt AS (
                 SELECT COALESCE(sum("Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS borrower_portfolio,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "Borrowers"."Has Active Loan" = true) AS active_borrowers
                   FROM "Borrowers"
                ), a AS (
                 SELECT b_1."Row ID",
                    b_1."Borrower Name",
                    b_1."Description",
                    b_1."Creation Date",
                    b_1."Hidden Flag",
                    b_1."Communication Name",
                    b_1."Instagram Username",
                    b_1."AI Collection Enabled",
                    b_1."City",
                    b_1."Working Location",
                    b_1."Address",
                    b_1."Total Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Total Amount Loaned",
                    b_1."Total Number of Loans",
                    b_1."Total Outstanding Principal",
                    b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned",
                    b_1."Active Daily Interest",
                    b_1."Has Closed Loan",
                    b_1."Has Active Loan",
                    b_1."Ref Referrer",
                        CASE
                            WHEN b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned" / b_1."Total Outstanding Principal"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Return on Active Principal",
                    COALESCE(rr.profit30, 0::numeric) AS "Profit Last 30 Days",
                    COALESCE(rr.profit10, 0::numeric) AS "Profit Last 10 Days",
                        CASE
                            WHEN b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" <= 0::numeric THEN NULL::date
                            WHEN b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned" >= b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" THEN ctx.d
                            WHEN b_1."Active Daily Interest" > 0::numeric THEN ctx.d + ceil((b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" - b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned") / b_1."Active Daily Interest")::integer
                            ELSE NULL::date
                        END AS "Projected Interest Coverage Date",
                    COALESCE(b_1."Total Interest Earned", 0::numeric) - COALESCE(b_1."Active Loan Interest Earned", 0::numeric) AS "Closed Loan Interest Earned",
                    COALESCE(b_1."Total Amount Loaned", 0::numeric) - COALESCE(b_1."Total Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) AS "Closed Loan Principle",
                    COALESCE(lr.gross_days, 0::numeric) AS "30D Gross Principal Days",
                    COALESCE(rr.reduction, 0::numeric) AS "30D Principal Reduction Days",
                    round((COALESCE(lr.gross_days, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(rr.reduction, 0::numeric)) / 30::numeric) AS "30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(cr.collection_count, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN NULL::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_overdue > 0 THEN 'Overdue'::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_pending = 0 AND cr.collection_partial = 0 THEN 'Fully Paid'::text
                            WHEN cr.collection_partial > 0 OR cr.collection_paid > 0 AND cr.collection_pending > 0 THEN 'Partially Paid'::text
                            ELSE 'Not Paid'::text
                        END AS "Daily Collection Status",
                    COALESCE(cr.collection_due, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Due",
                    COALESCE(cash.collected, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Collected",
                    COALESCE(cr.collection_remaining, 0::numeric) AS "Todays Amount Remaining",
                        CASE
                            WHEN bt.borrower_portfolio = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                            ELSE COALESCE(b_1."Total Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) / bt.borrower_portfolio
                        END AS "Portfolio Exposure %",
                    COALESCE(lr.active, 0::bigint) AS "Active Loan Count",
                    COALESCE(lr.oldest, 0) AS "Oldest Active Loan Age",
                    COALESCE(cr.overdue, 0::numeric) AS "Overdue Amount",
                    COALESCE(cr.overdue_count, 0::bigint) AS "Overdue Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.history, 0::bigint) AS "Historical Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.ontime, 0::bigint) AS "On Time Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_count, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D Charge Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_ontime, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D On Time Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.late_count, 0::bigint) AS "Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                    COALESCE(cr.recent_late, 0::bigint) AS "Recent 30D Late Payment Count",

                    cr.last_late AS "Last Late Payment Date",
                    COALESCE(lr.largest, 0::numeric) AS "Largest Successful Loan",

                    COALESCE(lr.defaults, 0::bigint) AS "Default Count",

                    pt.portfolio AS "Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                    COALESCE(rr.mtd, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(cr.interest_remaining, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(lr.forecast, 0::numeric) AS "Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                    bt.active_borrowers AS "Matrix Active Borrower Count",
                    1 / NULLIF(bt.active_borrowers, 0) AS "Matrix Equal Share Benchmark",
                    cr.recent_ontime * 100 / NULLIF(cr.recent_count, 0) AS "Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                    cr.ontime180 * 100 / NULLIF(cr.history180, 0) AS "Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                        CASE
                            WHEN COALESCE(cr.history90, 0::bigint) = 0 THEN NULL::integer
                            WHEN cr.default90 THEN 0
                            WHEN cr.late90 = 0 THEN 100
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 1 THEN 90
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 3 THEN 70
                            WHEN cr.late90 <= 7 THEN 40
                            ELSE 10
                        END AS "Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                        CASE
                            WHEN lr.current_default THEN 0
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late > 3 THEN 20
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late >= 2 THEN 40
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_late >= 1 THEN 60
                            WHEN cr.partial_today THEN 75
                            WHEN cr.unpaid_today > 0 THEN 90
                            ELSE 100
                        END AS "Matrix Current Condition Score",
                    COALESCE((ctx.d - cr.first_history) >= 3, true) AS "Matrix History Sufficient",
                    COALESCE(er.rebate, 0::numeric) AS "Total Referral Rebate Earned"
                   FROM "Borrowers" b_1
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                     CROSS JOIN pt
                     CROSS JOIN bt
                     LEFT JOIN lr ON lr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN rr ON rr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN cr ON cr.id = b_1."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN cash ON cash.id = b_1."Row ID"

                ), b AS (
                 SELECT a."Row ID",

                    a."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",

                    a."Total Referral Rebate Earned",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."Has Closed Loan" AND a."Closed Loan Principle" > 0::numeric THEN a."Closed Loan Interest Earned" / a."Closed Loan Principle"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Return on Closed Loans",
                        CASE
                            WHEN a."30D Average Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric THEN a."Profit Last 30 Days" / a."30D Average Outstanding Principal"
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "30D Return on Average Principal",
                        CASE

                        END AS "Lifetime On Time Rate",
                        CASE

                        END AS "Recent 30D On Time Rate",
                        CASE

                            ELSE NULL::numeric
                        END AS "Matrix Economic Contribution",
                    trunc(round(10::numeric * (COALESCE(a."Matrix Recent Reliability Score"::numeric * 0.45, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(a."Matrix Historical Reliability Score"::numeric * 0.20, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(a."Matrix Delay Severity Score"::numeric * 0.20, 0::numeric) + a."Matrix Current Condition Score"::numeric * 0.15) / (

SELECT old_view."Row ID",
    old_view."Ref Loans",

    old_view."Days Late",
    old_view."Historical On Time",
    old_view."Historical Late",
    old_view."Ref Collection Borrower",
    b."Payment Request Cash Account",
    b."Payment Request Token"
   FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                 SELECT q.d,
                    date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
                    (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
                   FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
                ), rp AS (
                 SELECT "Repayments"."Ref Charges" AS id,
                    min("Repayments"."Payment Date") AS first_date,
                    max("Repayments"."Payment Date") AS last_date,
                    bool_or("Repayments"."Payment Date" = ctx.d) AS today
                   FROM "Repayments"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                  GROUP BY "Repayments"."Ref Charges"
                ), a AS (
                 SELECT c."Row ID",
                    c."Ref Loans",
                    c."Charge Date",
                    c."Interest Due",
                    c."Principal Due",
                    c."Notes",
                    c."Principal Paid",
                    c."Interest Paid",
                    c."Total Paid",
                    c."Principal Remaining",
                    c."Interest Remaining",
                    c."Amount Remaining",
                    c."Payment Count",
                    c."Payment Status",
                    c."Payment Date",
                    COALESCE(c."Principal Due"::numeric, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(c."Interest Due"::numeric, 0::numeric) AS "Amount Due",
                    rp.first_date AS "First Payment Date",
                    rp.last_date AS "Last Payment Date",
                        CASE
                            WHEN c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระแล้ว'::text AND c."Payment Date" IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0, c."Payment Date" - c."Charge Date")
                            WHEN c."Charge Date" < ctx.d THEN ctx.d - c."Charge Date"
                            ELSE 0
                        END AS "Days Late",
                        CASE
                            WHEN c."Payment Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ชำระแล้ว'::text AND c."Charge Date" <= ctx.d OR c."Payment Status" = 'ชำระแล้ว'::text AND c."Payment Date" = ctx.d OR rp.today THEN l."Ref Borrowers"
                            ELSE NULL::text
                        END AS "Ref Collection Borrower"
                   FROM "Charges" c
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                     LEFT JOIN rp ON rp.id = c."Row ID"
                     LEFT JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
                ), final AS (
                 SELECT a."Row ID",
                    a."Ref Loans",
                    a."Charge Date",
                    a."Interest Due",
                    a."Principal Due",
                    a."Notes",
                    a."Principal Paid",
                    a."Interest Paid",
                    a."Total Paid",
                    a."Principal Remaining",
                    a."Interest Remaining",
                    a."Amount Remaining",
                    a."Payment Count",
                    a."Payment Status",
                    a."Payment Date",
                    a."Amount Due",
                    a."First Payment Date",
                    a."Last Payment Date",
                    a."Days Late",
                    a."Ref Collection Borrower",
                    COALESCE(a."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND a."Payment Status" = 'ชำระแล้ว'::text AND a."Days Late" = 0, false) AS "Historical On Time",
                    COALESCE(a."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND a."Days Late" > 0, false) AS "Historical Late"
                   FROM a
                     CROSS JOIN ctx
                )
         SELECT x."Row ID",
            x."Ref Loans",
            x."Charge Date",
            x."Interest Due",
            x."Principal Due",
            x."Notes",
            x."Principal Paid",
            x."Interest Paid",
            x."Total Paid",
            x."Principal Remaining",
            x."Interest Remaining",
            x."Amount Remaining",
            x."Payment Count",

           FROM ( WITH ctx AS (

                           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q

                        ), br AS (

                        ), a AS (

                            l_1."Principal Amount",
                            l_1."Due Date",
                            l_1."Ref Borrowers",

WHEN l_1."Loan Date" >= ctx.ms AND l_1."Loan Date" <= ctx.me THEN (ctx.d - l_1."Loan Date" + 1)::numeric
ELSE EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.d)

                             CROSS JOIN ctx

                        ), b AS (

                                    WHEN a."Loan Age Days" <= 30 THEN '21-30 Days'::text

                                    ELSE 0::numeric
                                END AS "Accrued Interest",
                                CASE

                                    ELSE 0::numeric

                                CASE
                                    WHEN COALESCE(a."Outstanding Principal", 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                                    ELSE
                                    CASE a."Loan Type"
WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN COALESCE(a."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) / a."Outstanding Principal"

                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Type" = 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN GREATEST(0::numeric, b_1."Accrued Interest") + COALESCE(b_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric) * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric
                                    WHEN b_1."Loan Type" = 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN

WHEN b_1."Due Date" > ctx.d AND b_1."Due Date" <= ctx.me THEN COALESCE(b_1."Fixed Interest"::numeric, 0::numeric)

relations.name: olap_portfolio_summary
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), lr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Outstanding Principal"), 0::numeric) AS principal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text) AS active,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Interest This Month"), 0::numeric) AS forecast,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Principal Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS days,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Expected Daily Interest Amount"), 0::numeric) AS daily,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_loans_analytics."Total Interest Received") FILTER (WHERE olap_loans_analytics."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text), 0::numeric) AS active_profit
           FROM olap_loans_analytics
        ), rr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS profit,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS today,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" = (ctx.d - 1)), 0::numeric) AS yesterday,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" <= ctx.me), 0::numeric) AS mtd,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Principal Returned Days MTD"), 0::numeric) AS returned_days,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_a,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit"), 0::numeric) AS profit_b
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), cr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Interest Remaining") FILTER (WHERE NULLIF(olap_charges_analytics."Ref Loans", ''::text) IS NOT NULL AND olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS interest,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Due") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS due,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Total Paid") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS paid,
            COALESCE(sum(olap_charges_analytics."Amount Remaining") FILTER (WHERE olap_charges_analytics."Charge Date" = ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS remaining
           FROM olap_charges_analytics
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), br AS (
         SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Fully Paid'::text) AS full_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Partially Paid'::text) AS partial_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Overdue'::text) AS overdue_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE olap_borrowers_analytics."Daily Collection Status" = 'Not Paid'::text) AS notpaid_count
           FROM olap_borrowers_analytics
        ), top3 AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(q.v), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM ( SELECT "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" AS v
                   FROM "Borrowers"
                  WHERE "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" > 0::numeric
                  ORDER BY "Borrowers"."Total Outstanding Principal" DESC
                 LIMIT 3) q
        ), pool AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions"
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(s."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Settlements" s
             JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
          WHERE s."Status" = 'Completed'::text
        ), earned AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(
                CASE p."Partner Role"
                    WHEN 'A'::text THEN rr.profit_a
                    WHEN 'B'::text THEN rr.profit_b
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END), 0::numeric) AS total
           FROM "Partners" p
             CROSS JOIN rr
        ), er AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS total,
            COALESCE(sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= ctx.ms AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS mtd
           FROM "Business Expenses"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), recent AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Snapshot Date",
            a."Generated At",
            a."Model Version",
            a."Principal Issued",
            a."Loans Issued",
            a."Principal Returned",
            a."Interest Received",
            a."Repayments Count",
            a."Outstanding Principal EOD",
            a."Active Loans EOD",
            a."Active Borrowers EOD",
            a."Pending Charges EOD",
            a."Total Cash Pool EOD",
            a."Available Cash EOD",
            a."Unsettled Profit EOD",
            a."Business Expenses",
            a."Net Profit",
            a."Net Unsettled Profit EOD"
           FROM "Daily Analytics" a
          WHERE a."Snapshot Date" >= ((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) - '30 days'::interval)
        ), peak AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(max(recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS amount
           FROM recent
        ), peakdate AS (
         SELECT max(recent."Snapshot Date") AS dt
           FROM recent
             CROSS JOIN peak
          WHERE recent."Outstanding Principal EOD"::numeric = peak.amount
        ), a AS (
         SELECT s."Row ID",
            s."Statistics ID",
            rr.profit AS "Total Profit",
            lr.principal AS "Outstanding Principal",
            lr.principal AS "Total Outstanding Principal",
            lr.active AS "Active Loans",
            rr.today AS "Today's Profit",
            rr.yesterday AS "Yesterday's Profit",
            rr.mtd AS "Realized Profit MTD",
            rr.mtd + cr.interest + lr.forecast AS "Projected Monthly Profit",
            cr.pending AS "Pending Payment Amount",
            lr.forecast AS "Forecast Remaining Interest",
            cr.interest AS "Today's Outstanding Interest",
            lr.days - rr.returned_days AS "Net Principal Days MTD",
            lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric AS "Forecast Remaining Principal Days",
            round((lr.days - rr.returned_days + lr.principal * (ctx.me - ctx.d)::numeric) / EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.me)) AS "Forecast Average Daily Outstanding Principal",
            peak.amount AS "Peak Cash Pool 30D",
            peakdate.dt AS "Peak Cash Pool Date 30D",
            lr.daily AS "Expected Daily Interest",
            lr.active_profit AS "Total Profit of Outstanding Loans",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal > 0::numeric THEN lr.active_profit / lr.principal
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Profit Coverage of Outstanding Principal",
            pool.total AS "Total Cash Pool",
            earned.total - settled.total AS "Total Unsettled Profit",
            pool.total - lr.principal + earned.total - settled.total AS "Expected Loan Account Balance",
                CASE
                    WHEN lr.principal = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE top3.total / lr.principal
                END AS "Top 3 Borrower Concentration",
            br.full_count AS "Borrowers Fully Paid Today",

relations.name: olap_repayments_analytics
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT q.d,
            date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS ms,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, q.d::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS me
           FROM ( SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d) q
        ), events AS (
         SELECT c."Contribution Date" AS dt,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                END) AS pool,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                END) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'A'::text) AS a,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
                END) FILTER (WHERE p."Partner Role" = 'B'::text) AS b
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions" c
             LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = c."Ref Partner"
          GROUP BY c."Contribution Date"
        ), running AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT events.dt,
            sum(events.pool) OVER w AS pool,
            sum(events.a) OVER w AS a,
            sum(events.b) OVER w AS b
           FROM events
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY events.dt ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
        ), a AS (
         SELECT r."Row ID",
            r."Payment Date",
            r."Principal Paid",
            r."Interest Paid",
            r."Notes",
            r."Ref Loans",
            r."Ref Charges",
            r."Created By",
            r."Ref Payment",
            r."Ref Payment Allocation",
            COALESCE(h.pool, 0::numeric) AS "Pool Total at Payment Date",
            COALESCE(h.a, 0::numeric) AS "Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
            COALESCE(h.b, 0::numeric) AS "Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
                CASE
                    WHEN h.pool > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(h.a, 0::numeric) / h.pool
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Partner A Profit Share",
                CASE
                    WHEN h.pool > 0::numeric THEN COALESCE(h.b, 0::numeric) / h.pool
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS "Partner B Profit Share",
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(r."Principal Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric OR r."Payment Date" > ctx.d THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE(r."Principal Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) *
                    CASE
                        WHEN r."Payment Date" >= ctx.ms AND r."Payment Date" <= ctx.me THEN (ctx.d - r."Payment Date" + 1)::numeric
                        ELSE EXTRACT(day FROM ctx.d)
                    END
                END AS "Principal Returned Days MTD",
                CASE
                    WHEN r."Payment Date" < (ctx.d - 29) OR r."Payment Date" > ctx.d THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE(r."Principal Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) * (ctx.d - r."Payment Date" + 1)::numeric
                END AS "30D Principal Reduction Days",
            COALESCE(r."Principal Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(r."Interest Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) AS "Amount Received"
           FROM "Repayments" r
             CROSS JOIN ctx
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT running.dt,
                    running.pool,
                    running.a,
                    running.b
                   FROM running
                  WHERE running.dt <= r."Payment Date"
                  ORDER BY running.dt DESC
                 LIMIT 1) h ON true
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID",
            a."Payment Date",
            a."Principal Paid",
            a."Interest Paid",
            a."Notes",
            a."Ref Loans",
            a."Ref Charges",
            a."Created By",
            a."Ref Payment",
            a."Ref Payment Allocation",
            a."Pool Total at Payment Date",
            a."Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
            a."Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
            a."Partner A Profit Share",
            a."Partner B Profit Share",
            a."Principal Returned Days MTD",
            a."30D Principal Reduction Days",
            a."Amount Received",
            round(COALESCE(a."Interest Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) * a."Partner A Profit Share") AS "Partner A Profit",
            round(COALESCE(a."Interest Paid"::numeric, 0::numeric) * a."Partner B Profit Share") AS "Partner B Profit"
           FROM a
        )
 SELECT "Row ID",
    "Payment Date",
    "Principal Paid",
    "Interest Paid",
    "Notes",
    "Ref Loans",
    "Ref Charges",
    "Created By",
    "Ref Payment",
    "Ref Payment Allocation",
    "Principal Returned Days MTD",
    round("Pool Total at Payment Date", 0) AS "Pool Total at Payment Date",
    round("Partner A Contribution at Payment Date", 0) AS "Partner A Contribution at Payment Date",
    round("Partner B Contribution at Payment Date", 0) AS "Partner B Contribution at Payment Date",
    round("Partner A Profit Share", 2) AS "Partner A Profit Share",
    round("Partner B Profit Share", 2) AS "Partner B Profit Share",
    round("Partner A Profit", 0) AS "Partner A Profit",
    round("Partner B Profit", 0) AS "Partner B Profit",
    round("30D Principal Reduction Days", 2) AS "30D Principal Reduction Days",
    round("Amount Received", 0) AS "Amount Received"
   FROM final x;
