relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_context_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
        ), counts AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(sum(oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1."Recorded Only Loans"), 0::bigint)::integer AS manual_loans,
            COALESCE(sum(oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1."Review Loans"), 0::bigint)::integer AS review_loans
           FROM oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1
        ), orphans AS (
         SELECT count(*)::integer AS n
           FROM "Charges" c
             LEFT JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
             LEFT JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = l."Ref Borrowers"
          WHERE b."Row ID" IS NULL
        )
 SELECT 'upcoming'::text AS "Row ID",
    ctx.t AS "As Of Date",
    ctx.t + 1 AS "From Date",
    ctx.t + 7 AS "Through Date",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    (to_char((ctx.t + 1)::timestamp with time zone, 'DD Mon YYYY'::text) || ' - '::text) || to_char((ctx.t + 7)::timestamp with time zone, 'DD Mon YYYY'::text) AS "Date Range",
    (
        CASE
            WHEN (counts.review_loans + orphans.n) > 0 THEN 'Partial forecast - source review required. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END ||
        CASE
            WHEN counts.manual_loans > 0 THEN 'Auto-off loans use recorded settlement charges only. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END) || 'Projected amounts assume scheduled principal is collected on its due date. Sync to refresh.'::text AS "Forecast Note"
   FROM ctx
     CROSS JOIN counts
     CROSS JOIN orphans;

relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_coverage_v1
relations.definition:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT i_1.borrower_id,
            i_1.loan_id,
            i_1.reporting_date,
            LEAST((i_1.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i_1.reporting_date + 93) AS horizon_end,
            s.due_date,
            s.origin,
            s.bucket,
            s.principal,
            s.interest,
            s.eligible,
            s.issue
           FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i_1
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL forecast_schedule_v1(i_1.loan, i_1.charges, i_1.reporting_date, LEAST((i_1.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i_1.reporting_date + 93)) s(due_date, origin, bucket, principal, interest, eligible, issue) ON true
        ), issues AS (
         SELECT raw.borrower_id,
            count(DISTINCT raw.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Notice'::text AND raw.bucket = 'Recorded plan only'::text)::integer AS manual_loans,
            count(DISTINCT raw.loan_id) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Exception'::text OR raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text AND raw.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text AND raw.due_date > raw.reporting_date)::integer AS review_loans,
            string_agg(DISTINCT raw.issue, '; '::text ORDER BY raw.issue) FILTER (WHERE raw.origin = 'Exception'::text) AS issue_text
           FROM raw
          GROUP BY raw.borrower_id
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT raw.borrower_id,
            LEAST(count(DISTINCT raw.due_date), 5::bigint)::integer AS displayed_dates
           FROM raw
          WHERE raw.due_date > raw.reporting_date AND raw.due_date <= raw.horizon_end AND (raw.principal + raw.interest) > 0::numeric AND (raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text OR raw.origin = 'Simulated'::text AND raw.eligible)
          GROUP BY raw.borrower_id
        ), ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
        )
 SELECT b."Row ID",
    b."Row ID" AS "Ref Borrower",
    ctx.t AS "As Of Date",
    LEAST((ctx.t + '3 mons'::interval)::date, ctx.t + 93) AS "Horizon End",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    COALESCE(d.displayed_dates, 0) AS "Displayed Dates",
    COALESCE(i.manual_loans, 0) AS "Recorded Only Loans",
    COALESCE(i.review_loans, 0) AS "Review Loans",
    ((
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.review_loans, 0) > 0 THEN 'Incomplete / review required. '::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END ||
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(d.displayed_dates, 0) = 0 THEN 'No upcoming charges within 3 months.'::text
            ELSE ('Showing '::text || d.displayed_dates) || ' due dates within 3 months.'::text
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(i.manual_loans, 0) > 0 THEN ' Auto-off loans: recorded settlement charges only.'::text
            ELSE ''::text
        END) ||
        CASE
            WHEN i.issue_text IS NOT NULL THEN ' '::text || i.issue_text
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS "Coverage Note"
   FROM "Borrowers" b
     CROSS JOIN ctx
     LEFT JOIN issues i ON i.borrower_id = b."Row ID"
     LEFT JOIN dates d ON d.borrower_id = b."Row ID";

relations.name: oltp_upcoming_charge_events_v1
relations.definition:
WITH raw AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT i.loan_id,
            i.borrower_id,
            i.loan,
            i.reporting_date,
            LEAST((i.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i.reporting_date + 93) AS horizon_end,
            s.due_date,
            s.origin,
            s.bucket,
            s.principal,
            s.interest,
            s.eligible,
            s.issue
           FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i
             JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = i.borrower_id
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL forecast_schedule_v1(i.loan, i.charges, i.reporting_date, LEAST((i.reporting_date + '3 mons'::interval)::date, i.reporting_date + 93)) s(due_date, origin, bucket, principal, interest, eligible, issue)
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT raw.loan_id,
            raw.borrower_id,
            raw.reporting_date,
            raw.horizon_end,
            raw.due_date,
            sum(raw.principal) AS principal,
            sum(raw.interest) AS interest,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_or(raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text) THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN bool_or(raw.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text) THEN 'Recorded - review status'::text
                        WHEN bool_and(NOT COALESCE((raw.loan ->> 'auto'::text)::boolean, false)) THEN 'Recorded settlement'::text
                        ELSE 'Recorded'::text
                    END
                    ELSE 'Projected'::text
                END AS basis
           FROM raw
          WHERE raw.due_date > raw.reporting_date AND raw.due_date <= raw.horizon_end AND (raw.principal + raw.interest) > 0::numeric AND (raw.origin = 'Recorded'::text OR raw.origin = 'Simulated'::text AND raw.eligible)
          GROUP BY raw.loan_id, raw.borrower_id, raw.reporting_date, raw.horizon_end, raw.due_date
        ), ranked AS (
         SELECT amounts.loan_id,
            amounts.borrower_id,
            amounts.reporting_date,
            amounts.horizon_end,
            amounts.due_date,
            amounts.principal,
            amounts.interest,
            amounts.basis,
            dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY amounts.borrower_id ORDER BY amounts.due_date)::integer AS due_rank
           FROM amounts
        )
 SELECT (((('uf1:'::text || length(loan_id)) || ':'::text) || loan_id) || ':'::text) || to_char(due_date::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text) AS "Row ID",
    borrower_id AS "Ref Borrower",
    loan_id AS "Ref Loan",
    due_date AS "Due Date",
    principal AS "Principal Remaining",
    interest AS "Interest Remaining",
    principal + interest AS "Amount Remaining",
    basis AS "Basis",
    reporting_date AS "As Of Date",
    horizon_end AS "Horizon End",
    statement_timestamp() AS "Calculated At",
    due_date <= (reporting_date + 7) AS "Within 7 Days",
    due_rank AS "Borrower Due Date Rank"
   FROM ranked
  WHERE due_date <= (reporting_date + 7) OR due_rank <= 5;

WITH events AS (

            reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal AS principal_issued,
            0::numeric AS principal_returned,
            0::numeric AS interest_received,
            1::bigint AS loans_issued,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'First loan'::text)::integer::bigint AS first_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'Repeat loan'::text)::integer::bigint AS repeat_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrowing_type = 'Unavailable'::text)::integer::bigint AS unclassified_loans,
            (reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id IS NULL)::integer::bigint AS invalid_events
           FROM reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1
        UNION ALL
         SELECT l."Ref Borrowers",
            r."Payment Date",
            0::numeric AS "numeric",
            r."Principal Paid"::numeric AS "Principal Paid",
            r."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Interest Paid",
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            0::bigint AS int8,
            (r."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR l."Ref Borrowers" IS NULL)::integer::bigint AS int8
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             LEFT JOIN olap_loans_analytics l ON l."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
        )
 SELECT borrower_id,
    activity_date,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(principal_issued IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(principal_issued)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS principal_issued,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(principal_returned IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(principal_returned)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS principal_returned,
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(interest_received IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(interest_received)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS interest_received,
    sum(loans_issued)::bigint AS loans_issued,
    sum(first_loans)::bigint AS first_loans,
    sum(repeat_loans)::bigint AS repeat_loans,
    sum(unclassified_loans)::bigint AS unclassified_loans,
    sum(invalid_events)::bigint AS invalid_events
   FROM events
  GROUP BY borrower_id, activity_date;

         SELECT reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id,
            count(*) AS loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.is_active) AS active_loans,
            min(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date) AS first_loan_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS principal,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.loan_date IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.original_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.outstanding_principal IS NULL OR reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.is_active IS NULL) AS invalid_loans
           FROM reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1.borrower_id
        ), payments AS (
         SELECT l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            max(r."Payment Date") FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= olap_reporting_date()) AS last_payment_date,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(r."Interest Paid" IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= olap_reporting_date())
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS lifetime_interest,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r."Interest Paid" IS NULL) AS invalid_payments
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             LEFT JOIN olap_loans_analytics l_1 ON l_1."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
          GROUP BY l_1."Ref Borrowers"
        ), names AS (
         SELECT b_1."Row ID" AS borrower_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(b_1."Description", ''::text), 'Unnamed borrower'::text) AS borrower_name,
            b_1."Hidden Flag" AS hidden_flag,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY (COALESCE(NULLIF(b_1."Description", ''::text), 'Unnamed borrower'::text))) AS name_count
           FROM olap_borrowers_analytics b_1
        )
 SELECT b.borrower_id,
    b.borrower_name,
    b.borrower_name ||
        CASE
            WHEN b.name_count > 1 THEN ' · '::text || b.borrower_id
            ELSE ''::text
        END AS borrower_label,
    b.hidden_flag,
    COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0::bigint) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0::bigint) AS active_loans,
    COALESCE(l.active_loans, 0::bigint) > 0 AS has_active_loan,
    l.first_loan_date,
        CASE
            WHEN l.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE l.principal
        END AS outstanding_principal,
    p.last_payment_date,
        CASE
            WHEN p.borrower_id IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            WHEN p.invalid_payments > 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE COALESCE(p.lifetime_interest, 0::numeric)
        END AS lifetime_interest,
    COALESCE(l.invalid_loans, 0::bigint) + COALESCE(p.invalid_payments, 0::bigint) AS invalid_fact_count,
    olap_reporting_date() AS reporting_date,
    statement_timestamp() AS calculated_at
   FROM names b
     LEFT JOIN loans l USING (borrower_id)
     LEFT JOIN payments p USING (borrower_id);

relations.name: reporting_borrower_matrix_plot_v1
relations.definition:
WITH inputs AS (
         SELECT m.borrower_id,
            m.contribution_30d,
            m.active_borrower_count,
            m.portfolio_contribution_30d,
            m.contribution_share,
            m.equal_share,
            m.relative_contribution,
            m.reliability_score,
            m.confidence,
            m.quadrant,
            m.classification_reason,
            m.outstanding_principal,
            m.reporting_date,
            m.calculated_at,
            m.method_version,
            m.payment_only_quadrant,
            m.arrangement_status,
            m.arrangement_gate,
            m.modified_schedule_loan_count,
            m.interest_coverage_30d,
            m.interest_date_coverage_30d,
            m.category_adjusted,
                CASE
                    WHEN m.quadrant = 'Unclassified'::text THEN 'Unclassified'::text
                    WHEN (m.quadrant <> ALL (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text, 'Question Mark'::text, 'Dog'::text])) OR m.reliability_score IS NULL OR m.reliability_score < 0::numeric OR m.reliability_score > 100::numeric OR m.relative_contribution IS NULL OR (m.relative_contribution::text = ANY (ARRAY['NaN'::text, 'Infinity'::text, '-Infinity'::text])) OR m.arrangement_gate IS NULL THEN 'Invalid plot input'::text
                    WHEN (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text])) <> (m.reliability_score >= 80::numeric AND NOT m.arrangement_gate) OR (m.quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Question Mark'::text])) <> (m.relative_contribution >= 1::numeric) THEN 'Invalid plot input'::text
                    ELSE 'Plotted'::text
                END AS plot_status
           FROM reporting_borrower_matrix_v3 m
        ), coordinates AS (
         SELECT i.borrower_id,
            i.contribution_30d,
            i.active_borrower_count,
            i.portfolio_contribution_30d,
            i.contribution_share,
            i.equal_share,
            i.relative_contribution,
            i.reliability_score,
            i.confidence,
            i.quadrant,
            i.classification_reason,
            i.outstanding_principal,
            i.reporting_date,
            i.calculated_at,
            i.method_version,
            i.payment_only_quadrant,
            i.arrangement_status,
            i.arrangement_gate,
            i.modified_schedule_loan_count,
            i.interest_coverage_30d,
            i.interest_date_coverage_30d,
            i.category_adjusted,
            i.plot_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN i.plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.arrangement_gate THEN 75::numeric
                        WHEN i.reliability_score < 80::numeric THEN 100::numeric - 50::numeric * i.reliability_score / 80::numeric
                        ELSE 50::numeric - 50::numeric * (i.reliability_score - 80::numeric) / 20::numeric
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS matrix_x,
                CASE
                    WHEN i.plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN i.relative_contribution < 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                        ELSE 100::numeric * i.relative_contribution / (1::numeric + i.relative_contribution)
                    END
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS matrix_y
           FROM inputs i
        )
 SELECT borrower_id,
    contribution_30d,
    active_borrower_count,
    portfolio_contribution_30d,
    contribution_share,
    equal_share,
    relative_contribution,
    reliability_score,
    confidence,
    quadrant,
    classification_reason,
    outstanding_principal,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    method_version,
    payment_only_quadrant,
    arrangement_status,
    arrangement_gate,
    modified_schedule_loan_count,
    interest_coverage_30d,
    interest_date_coverage_30d,
    category_adjusted,
    plot_status,
    matrix_x,
    matrix_y,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Cash Cow'::text]) THEN GREATEST(2::numeric, LEAST(49.5, matrix_x))
                ELSE GREATEST(50.5, LEAST(98::numeric, matrix_x))
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS plot_x,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN quadrant = ANY (ARRAY['Star'::text, 'Question Mark'::text]) THEN GREATEST(50.5, LEAST(98::numeric, matrix_y))
                ELSE GREATEST(2::numeric, LEAST(49.5, matrix_y))
            END
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS plot_y,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status <> 'Plotted'::text THEN plot_status
            WHEN arrangement_gate THEN 'Modified-schedule category placement'::text
            ELSE 'Measured score'::text
        END AS position_basis,
        CASE
            WHEN plot_status = 'Plotted'::text THEN relative_contribution < 0::numeric
            ELSE false
        END AS contribution_clipped,
    'bcg-display-v1'::text AS plot_method_version
   FROM coordinates c;

                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS contribution_share,

relations.name: reporting_borrower_payment_health_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d,
            statement_timestamp() AS t
        ), unattributed AS (
         SELECT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM "Repayments" r
                     LEFT JOIN "Charges" c ON c."Row ID" = r."Ref Charges"
                  WHERE c."Row ID" IS NULL)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM reporting_charge_payment_health_v1
                  WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.borrower_id IS NULL)) AS bad
        ), charges AS (
         SELECT reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.borrower_id,
            sum(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.principal_remaining_current) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.is_overdue) AS overdue_principal,
            sum(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.interest_remaining_current) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.is_overdue) AS overdue_interest,
            sum(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.overdue_amount) AS overdue_amount,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.is_overdue)::integer AS overdue_charge_count,
            min(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.is_overdue) AS oldest_overdue_date,
            max(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.current_days_overdue) AS oldest_unpaid_days,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 30))::integer AS recent_obligation_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 30) AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.on_time)::integer AS recent_on_time_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 180) AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date < (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 30))::integer AS older_obligation_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 180) AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date < (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 30) AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.on_time)::integer AS older_on_time_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 90))::integer AS severity_obligation_count,
            avg(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.delay_grade) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible AND reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date >= (reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.reporting_date - 90)) AS mean_delay_score,
            min(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible) AS first_matured_due_date,
            count(DISTINCT reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.due_date) FILTER (WHERE reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.history_eligible)::integer AS distinct_matured_due_dates,
            bool_or(reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.data_quality_status <> 'OK'::text) AS invalid
           FROM reporting_charge_payment_health_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_charge_payment_health_v1.borrower_id
        ), defaults AS (
         SELECT l."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted")::integer AS default_count,
            COALESCE(sum(l."Default Loss Amount"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE l."Defaulted"), 0::numeric) AS recorded_default_loss,
            bool_or(COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) AND l."Loan Date" <= ctx.d AND (l."Close Date" IS NULL OR l."Close Date" > ctx.d)) AS active_default,
            bool_or(COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) AND l."Close Date" >= (ctx.d - 90) AND l."Close Date" <= ctx.d) AS recent_default,
            bool_or(l."Loan Date" IS NULL OR l."Close Date" IS NOT NULL AND l."Close Date" < l."Loan Date") AS invalid
           FROM "Loans" l
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          GROUP BY l."Ref Borrowers"
        ), base AS (
         SELECT b."Row ID" AS borrower_id,
            COALESCE(b."Has Active Loan", false) AS has_active_loan,
            COALESCE(b."Hidden Flag", false) AS hidden_flag,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(c.invalid, false) OR u.bad THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE(c.overdue_principal, 0::numeric)
                END AS overdue_principal,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(c.invalid, false) OR u.bad THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE(c.overdue_interest, 0::numeric)
                END AS overdue_interest,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(c.invalid, false) OR u.bad THEN NULL::numeric
                    ELSE COALESCE(c.overdue_amount, 0::numeric)
                END AS overdue_amount,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(c.invalid, false) OR u.bad THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE COALESCE(c.overdue_charge_count, 0)
                END AS overdue_charge_count,
            c.oldest_overdue_date,
            c.oldest_unpaid_days,
            COALESCE(c.recent_obligation_count, 0) AS recent_obligation_count,
            COALESCE(c.recent_on_time_count, 0) AS recent_on_time_count,
            COALESCE(c.older_obligation_count, 0) AS older_obligation_count,
            COALESCE(c.older_on_time_count, 0) AS older_on_time_count,
            COALESCE(c.severity_obligation_count, 0) AS severity_obligation_count,
            c.first_matured_due_date,
            COALESCE(c.distinct_matured_due_dates, 0) AS distinct_matured_due_dates,
            ctx.d - c.first_matured_due_date AS history_span_days,
            c.recent_on_time_count::numeric / NULLIF(c.recent_obligation_count, 0)::numeric AS recent_on_time_rate,
            c.older_on_time_count::numeric / NULLIF(c.older_obligation_count, 0)::numeric AS older_on_time_rate,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(l.recent_default, false) THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE c.mean_delay_score
                END AS delay_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(l.active_default, false) THEN 0
                    WHEN c.oldest_unpaid_days IS NULL THEN 100
                    WHEN c.oldest_unpaid_days = 1 THEN 60
                    WHEN c.oldest_unpaid_days <= 3 THEN 40
                    ELSE 20
                END::numeric AS current_score,
            COALESCE(l.default_count, 0) AS default_count,
            COALESCE(l.recorded_default_loss, 0::numeric) AS recorded_default_loss,
            COALESCE(l.active_default, false) AS active_default,
            COALESCE(l.recent_default, false) AS recent_default,
                CASE
                    WHEN u.bad OR COALESCE(c.invalid, false) OR COALESCE(l.invalid, false) THEN 'Invalid source'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(l.default_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'Default history requires review'::text
                    ELSE 'OK'::text
                END AS data_quality_status,
            ctx.d AS reporting_date,
            ctx.t AS calculated_at
           FROM "Borrowers" b
             CROSS JOIN ctx
             CROSS JOIN unattributed u
             LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.borrower_id = b."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN defaults l ON l.borrower_id = b."Row ID"
        ), components AS (
         SELECT base.borrower_id,
            base.has_active_loan,
            base.hidden_flag,
            base.overdue_principal,
            base.overdue_interest,
            base.overdue_amount,
            base.overdue_charge_count,
            base.oldest_overdue_date,
            base.oldest_unpaid_days,
            base.recent_obligation_count,
            base.recent_on_time_count,
            base.older_obligation_count,
            base.older_on_time_count,
            base.severity_obligation_count,
            base.first_matured_due_date,
            base.distinct_matured_due_dates,
            base.history_span_days,
            base.recent_on_time_rate,
            base.older_on_time_rate,
            base.delay_score,
            base.current_score,
            base.default_count,
            base.recorded_default_loss,
            base.active_default,
            base.recent_default,
            base.data_quality_status,
            base.reporting_date,
            base.calculated_at,
            base.recent_obligation_count - base.recent_on_time_count AS recent_late_count,
            100::numeric * base.recent_on_time_rate AS recent_score,
            100::numeric * base.older_on_time_rate AS older_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN base.recent_on_time_rate IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE 0.45
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN base.older_on_time_rate IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE 0.15
                END +
                CASE
                    WHEN base.delay_score IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE 0.15
                END + 0.25 AS weight_total,
            COALESCE(base.oldest_unpaid_days > 7, false) OR base.active_default OR base.recent_default AS severe_risk_guard,
                CASE
                    WHEN base.data_quality_status <> 'OK'::text THEN 'Data review'::text
                    WHEN base.recent_obligation_count = 0 THEN 'Unclassified'::text
                    ELSE 'Rated'::text
                END AS rating_status
           FROM base
        ), raw AS (
         SELECT components.borrower_id,
            components.has_active_loan,
            components.hidden_flag,
            components.overdue_principal,
            components.overdue_interest,
            components.overdue_amount,
            components.overdue_charge_count,
            components.oldest_overdue_date,
            components.oldest_unpaid_days,
            components.recent_obligation_count,
            components.recent_on_time_count,
            components.older_obligation_count,
            components.older_on_time_count,
            components.severity_obligation_count,
            components.first_matured_due_date,
            components.distinct_matured_due_dates,
            components.history_span_days,
            components.recent_on_time_rate,
            components.older_on_time_rate,
            components.delay_score,
            components.current_score,
            components.default_count,
            components.recorded_default_loss,
            components.active_default,
            components.recent_default,
            components.data_quality_status,
            components.reporting_date,
            components.calculated_at,
            components.recent_late_count,
            components.recent_score,
            components.older_score,
            components.weight_total,
            components.severe_risk_guard,
            components.rating_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN components.rating_status = 'Rated'::text THEN (COALESCE(components.recent_score * 0.45, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(components.older_score * 0.15, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(components.delay_score * 0.15, 0::numeric) + components.current_score * 0.25) / components.weight_total
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS raw_score
           FROM components
        ), scored AS (
         SELECT raw.borrower_id,
            raw.has_active_loan,
            raw.hidden_flag,
            raw.overdue_principal,
            raw.overdue_interest,
            raw.overdue_amount,
            raw.overdue_charge_count,
            raw.oldest_overdue_date,
            raw.oldest_unpaid_days,
            raw.recent_obligation_count,
            raw.recent_on_time_count,
            raw.older_obligation_count,
            raw.older_on_time_count,
            raw.severity_obligation_count,
            raw.first_matured_due_date,
            raw.distinct_matured_due_dates,
            raw.history_span_days,
            raw.recent_on_time_rate,
            raw.older_on_time_rate,
            raw.delay_score,
            raw.current_score,
            raw.default_count,
            raw.recorded_default_loss,
            raw.active_default,
            raw.recent_default,
            raw.data_quality_status,
            raw.reporting_date,
            raw.calculated_at,
            raw.recent_late_count,
            raw.recent_score,
            raw.older_score,
            raw.weight_total,
            raw.severe_risk_guard,
            raw.rating_status,
            raw.raw_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN raw.severe_risk_guard THEN LEAST(raw.raw_score, 60::numeric)
                    ELSE raw.raw_score
                END AS candidate_score,
                CASE
                    WHEN raw.rating_status = 'Data review'::text THEN 'Data review'::text
                    WHEN raw.rating_status = 'Unclassified'::text THEN 'Insufficient history'::text
                    WHEN raw.distinct_matured_due_dates >= 3 AND raw.history_span_days >= 30 THEN 'Established'::text
                    ELSE 'Provisional'::text
                END AS confidence,
                CASE
                    WHEN raw.overdue_amount IS NULL THEN 'Data review'::text
                    WHEN raw.active_default OR raw.recent_default THEN 'Default flagged'::text
                    WHEN raw.overdue_charge_count > 0 THEN 'Overdue'::text
                    ELSE 'No current overdue'::text
                END AS current_health_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN raw.data_quality_status <> 'OK'::text THEN 'DATA_REVIEW'::text
                    WHEN raw.active_default THEN 'ACTIVE_DEFAULT'::text
                    WHEN raw.recent_default THEN 'RECENT_DEFAULT'::text
                    WHEN raw.oldest_unpaid_days > 7 THEN 'SEVERE_ARREARS'::text
                    WHEN raw.overdue_charge_count > 0 THEN 'CURRENT_ARREARS'::text
                    WHEN raw.recent_obligation_count = 0 THEN 'NO_RECENT_HISTORY'::text
                    WHEN raw.recent_late_count > 0 THEN 'RECENT_LATE_PAYMENTS'::text
                    WHEN raw.distinct_matured_due_dates < 3 OR raw.history_span_days < 30 THEN 'PROVISIONAL_HISTORY'::text
                    ELSE 'NO_CURRENT_ARREARS'::text
                END AS primary_reason_code
           FROM raw
        )
 SELECT borrower_id,
    has_active_loan,
    hidden_flag,
    overdue_principal,
    overdue_interest,
    overdue_amount,
    overdue_charge_count,
    oldest_overdue_date,
    oldest_unpaid_days,
    recent_obligation_count,
    recent_on_time_count,
    recent_late_count,
    recent_on_time_rate,
    older_obligation_count,
    older_on_time_count,
    older_on_time_rate,
    severity_obligation_count,
    first_matured_due_date,
    distinct_matured_due_dates,
    history_span_days,
    recent_score,
    older_score,
    delay_score,
    current_score,
        CASE
            WHEN recent_score IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE 0.45 / weight_total
        END AS recent_effective_weight,
        CASE
            WHEN older_score IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE 0.15 / weight_total
        END AS older_effective_weight,
        CASE
            WHEN delay_score IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
            ELSE 0.15 / weight_total
        END AS delay_effective_weight,
    0.25 / weight_total AS current_effective_weight,
    raw_score,
        CASE
            WHEN rating_status = 'Rated'::text THEN candidate_score
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS reliability_score,
        CASE
            WHEN rating_status = 'Rated'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN candidate_score >= 80::numeric THEN 'High'::text
                ELSE 'Lower'::text
            END
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS reliability_band,
    rating_status,
    confidence,
    severe_risk_guard,
    COALESCE(severe_risk_guard AND raw_score > 60::numeric, false) AS score_cap_applied,
    active_default,
    recent_default,
    default_count,
    recorded_default_loss,
    current_health_status,
    primary_reason_code,
        CASE primary_reason_code
            WHEN 'DATA_REVIEW'::text THEN data_quality_status
            WHEN 'ACTIVE_DEFAULT'::text THEN 'Active default recorded'::text
            WHEN 'RECENT_DEFAULT'::text THEN 'Default recorded within 90 days'::text
            WHEN 'SEVERE_ARREARS'::text THEN ('Oldest unpaid obligation is '::text || oldest_unpaid_days) || ' days overdue; severe-risk guard applies'::text
            WHEN 'CURRENT_ARREARS'::text THEN ('Oldest unpaid obligation is '::text || oldest_unpaid_days) || ' days overdue'::text
            WHEN 'NO_RECENT_HISTORY'::text THEN 'No eligible obligations in the last 30 completed days'::text
            WHEN 'RECENT_LATE_PAYMENTS'::text THEN ((recent_late_count || ' of '::text) || recent_obligation_count) || ' recent obligations were not paid on time'::text
            WHEN 'PROVISIONAL_HISTORY'::text THEN 'Limited payment history; rating is provisional'::text
            ELSE 'No current overdue; observed recent obligations paid on time'::text
        END AS reason_text,
    data_quality_status,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    'payment-health-v1'::text AS method_version
   FROM scored;

relations.name: reporting_borrower_payments_v1

relations.name: reporting_borrower_schedule_health_v1
relations.definition:
WITH a AS (
         SELECT reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.borrower_id,
            count(*)::integer AS active_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.modified_schedule)::integer AS modified_schedule_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text)::integer AS unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.assessment_eligible)::integer AS assessed_loan_count,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.expected_interest_30d) AS expected_interest_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_interest_30d) AS recorded_interest_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_principal_30d) AS recorded_principal_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.expected_due_dates_30d) AS expected_due_dates_30d,
            sum(reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.recorded_interest_dates_30d) AS recorded_interest_dates_30d
           FROM reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1.borrower_id
        )
 SELECT b."Row ID" AS borrower_id,
    COALESCE(a.active_loan_count, 0) AS active_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.modified_schedule_loan_count, 0) AS modified_schedule_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count, 0) AS unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count,
    COALESCE(a.assessed_loan_count, 0) AS assessed_loan_count,
    a.expected_interest_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_30d,
    a.recorded_principal_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_30d / NULLIF(a.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric) AS interest_coverage_30d,
    a.recorded_interest_dates_30d::numeric / NULLIF(a.expected_due_dates_30d, 0)::numeric AS interest_date_coverage_30d,
    COALESCE(a.modified_schedule_loan_count > 0, false) AS arrangement_gate,
        CASE
            WHEN a.modified_schedule_loan_count > 0 THEN 'Modified payment schedule'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(a.active_loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'No active loans'::text
            WHEN a.unsupported_or_invalid_loan_count > 0 THEN 'Not assessed: source/product'::text
            WHEN a.assessed_loan_count = 0 THEN 'Insufficient observation'::text
            ELSE 'No schedule restriction'::text
        END AS arrangement_status,
    olap_reporting_date() AS reporting_date,
    statement_timestamp() AS calculated_at,
    'schedule-health-v1'::text AS method_version
   FROM "Borrowers" b
     LEFT JOIN a ON a.borrower_id = b."Row ID";

relations.name: reporting_cash_account_daily
relations.definition:
WITH days AS (
         SELECT reporting_income_daily."Date"
           FROM reporting_income_daily
        ), flows AS (
         SELECT "Cash Ledger"."Ref To Cash Account" AS account,
            "Cash Ledger"."Movement Date" AS d,
            "Cash Ledger"."Amount" AS amount
           FROM "Cash Ledger"
          WHERE "Cash Ledger"."Ref To Cash Account" IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
         SELECT "Cash Ledger"."Ref From Cash Account",
            "Cash Ledger"."Movement Date",
            - "Cash Ledger"."Amount"
           FROM "Cash Ledger"
          WHERE "Cash Ledger"."Ref From Cash Account" IS NOT NULL
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT flows.account,
            flows.d,
            sum(flows.amount) AS amount
           FROM flows
          GROUP BY flows.account, flows.d
        ), positions AS (
         SELECT d."Date",
            a."Row ID" AS account,
            a."Ref Cash Holder" AS holder,
            h."Holder Name",
            a."Account Label",
            (c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS available_from,
                CASE
                    WHEN d."Date" >= (c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date THEN c."Opening Balance" - c."Baseline Cash In" + c."Baseline Cash Out" + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(f.amount) AS sum
                       FROM daily f
                      WHERE f.account = a."Row ID" AND f.d <= d."Date"), 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS balance
           FROM days d
             CROSS JOIN "Cash Accounts" a
             JOIN "Cash Holders" h ON h."Row ID" = a."Ref Cash Holder"
             LEFT JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account" = a."Row ID"
        )
 SELECT jsonb_build_array(account, "Date")::text AS "Position ID",
    "Date",
    account AS "Cash Account ID",
    holder AS "Cash Holder ID",
    "Holder Name" AS "Cash Holder",
    "Account Label" AS "Account",
    balance AS "Current Balance",
        CASE
            WHEN balance IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(balance, 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Business Cash Held",
        CASE
            WHEN balance IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(- balance, 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Advance Due",
    available_from AS "Available From",
        CASE
            WHEN balance IS NOT NULL THEN 'Available'::text
            ELSE 'Before opening baseline or opening missing'::text
        END AS "Balance Status",
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and(balance IS NOT NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY "Date", holder) THEN GREATEST(balance, 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Holder Cash Component"
   FROM positions;

relations.name: reporting_cash_account_snapshot
relations.definition:
SELECT a."Row ID",
    a."Snapshot Date",
    a."Ref Cash Account",
    a."Generated At",
    a."Model Version",
    a."Money In",
    a."Money Out",
    a."Opening Balance",
    a."Closing Balance",
    a."Transaction Count",
    a."Available From",
    a."Balance Status",
    c."Ref Cash Holder",
    c."Account Label",
    h."Holder Name",
    a."Money In" - a."Money Out" AS "Net Movement",
        CASE
            WHEN a."Closing Balance" IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(a."Closing Balance", 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Positive Cash Balance",
        CASE
            WHEN a."Closing Balance" IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(- a."Closing Balance", 0::numeric)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Negative Balance Amount",
    a."Snapshot Date" = olap_reporting_date() AS "Provisional",
    'Hourly snapshot'::text AS "Freshness Basis"
   FROM "Cash Account Daily Analytics" a
     JOIN "Cash Accounts" c ON c."Row ID" = a."Ref Cash Account"
     JOIN "Cash Holders" h ON h."Row ID" = c."Ref Cash Holder";

relations.name: reporting_cash_accounts
relations.definition:
SELECT "Ref Cash Account" AS "Cash Account ID",
    "Ref Cash Holder" AS "Cash Holder ID",
    "Holder Name" AS "Cash Holder",
    "Account Label" AS "Account",
    "Current Balance",
    "Initialized",
    "Business Cash Held",
    "Reimbursement / Advance Due" AS "Advance Due",
        CASE
            WHEN bool_and("Initialized") OVER (PARTITION BY "Ref Cash Holder") THEN "Business Cash Held"
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS "Holder Cash Component",
        CASE
            WHEN "Initialized" THEN 'Known'::text
            ELSE 'Opening balance missing'::text
        END AS "Balance Status"
   FROM "Cash Account Balances";

relations.name: reporting_cash_daily
relations.definition:
WITH days AS (
         SELECT reporting_income_daily."Date",
            reporting_income_daily."Month",
            reporting_income_daily."Operating Income",
            reporting_income_daily."Expenses",
            reporting_income_daily."Signed Expenses",
            reporting_income_daily."Net Profit",
            reporting_income_daily."Partner A Net Profit",
            reporting_income_daily."Partner B Net Profit",
            reporting_income_daily."Prior Partner A Net",
            reporting_income_daily."Prior Partner B Net",
            reporting_income_daily."Partner A Settled Through Date",
            reporting_income_daily."Partner B Settled Through Date",
            reporting_income_daily."Net Profit Through Date"
           FROM reporting_income_daily
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT "Cash Pool Contributions"."Contribution Date" AS d,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                    ELSE - "Cash Pool Contributions"."Amount"::numeric
                END) AS amount
           FROM "Cash Pool Contributions"
          GROUP BY "Cash Pool Contributions"."Contribution Date"
        ), loans AS (
         SELECT "Loans"."Loan Date" AS d,
            sum("Loans"."Principal Amount"::numeric) AS amount
           FROM "Loans"
          GROUP BY "Loans"."Loan Date"
        ), repayments AS (
         SELECT r."Payment Date" AS d,
            sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) AS amount
           FROM "Repayments" r
             JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = r."Ref Loans"
          GROUP BY r."Payment Date"
        ), custody AS (
         SELECT reporting_cash_account_daily."Date",
            bool_and(reporting_cash_account_daily."Current Balance" IS NOT NULL) AS complete,
            sum(reporting_cash_account_daily."Business Cash Held") AS held,
            sum(reporting_cash_account_daily."Advance Due") AS advance,
            max(reporting_cash_account_daily."Available From") AS available_from
           FROM reporting_cash_account_daily
          GROUP BY reporting_cash_account_daily."Date"
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT d."Date",
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM capital
                      WHERE capital.d IS NULL)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM loans
                      WHERE loans.d IS NULL)) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM repayments
                      WHERE repayments.d IS NULL)) THEN COALESCE(( SELECT sum(c_1.amount) AS sum
                       FROM capital c_1
                      WHERE c_1.d <= d."Date"), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(l.amount) AS sum
                       FROM loans l
                      WHERE l.d <= d."Date"), 0::numeric) + COALESCE(( SELECT sum(r.amount) AS sum
                       FROM repayments r
                      WHERE r.d <= d."Date"), 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS pool,
            d."Net Profit Through Date" - d."Partner A Settled Through Date" - d."Partner B Settled Through Date" AS retained,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.complete THEN c.held
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS held,
                CASE
                    WHEN c.complete THEN c.advance
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS advance,
            c.available_from
           FROM days d
             LEFT JOIN custody c ON c."Date" = d."Date"
        )
 SELECT "Date",
    pool AS "Cash Pool Remaining",
    held AS "Business Cash Held",
    advance AS "Advance Due",
    retained AS "Retained Profit Through Date",
    held - advance - pool - retained AS "Cash Reconciliation Difference",
    available_from AS "Cash Available From",
        CASE
            WHEN held IS NULL THEN 'Cash unavailable before account openings'::text
            WHEN pool IS NULL THEN 'Cash pool unavailable: source date missing'::text
            WHEN abs(held - advance - pool - retained) < 0.005 THEN 'Reconciled'::text
            ELSE 'Includes a cash reconciliation difference'::text
        END AS "Cash Status"
   FROM amounts;

relations.name: reporting_cash_entries
relations.definition:
WITH scopes AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID" AS id,
            a."Account Label" AS label,
            (c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS available,
            c."Opening Balance" - c."Baseline Cash In" + c."Baseline Cash Out" AS baseline
           FROM "Cash Accounts" a
             LEFT JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account" = a."Row ID"
        ), all_scopes AS (
         SELECT scopes.id,
            scopes.label,
            scopes.available,
            scopes.baseline
           FROM scopes
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '__ALL__'::text,
            'All accounts'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(scopes.available IS NOT NULL) THEN max(scopes.available)
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(scopes.baseline IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(scopes.baseline)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS "case"
           FROM scopes
        ), effects AS (
         SELECT e."Row ID",
            e.ledger_id,
            e.direction,
            e."Ref Cash Account",
            e."Statement Date",
            e."Sort Timestamp",
            e."Statement Time",
            e."Signed Amount",

relations.name: reporting_cashflow_daily
relations.definition:
WITH accounts AS (
         SELECT a."Row ID" AS scope,
            a."Account Label" AS label,
            (c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS available,
            c."Opening Balance" - c."Baseline Cash In" + c."Baseline Cash Out" AS baseline
           FROM "Cash Accounts" a
             LEFT JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON c."Ref Cash Account" = a."Row ID"
        ), scopes AS (
         SELECT accounts.scope,
            accounts.label,
            accounts.available,
            accounts.baseline
           FROM accounts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT '__ALL__'::text,
            'All accounts'::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(accounts.available IS NOT NULL) THEN max(accounts.available)
                    ELSE NULL::date
                END AS "case",
                CASE
                    WHEN bool_and(accounts.baseline IS NOT NULL) THEN sum(accounts.baseline)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS "case"
           FROM accounts
        ), flows AS (
         SELECT reporting_cashflow_transactions."Scope ID" AS scope,
            reporting_cashflow_transactions."Date" AS d,
            sum(reporting_cashflow_transactions."Money In") AS cash_in,
            sum(reporting_cashflow_transactions."Money Out") AS cash_out,
            count(*) AS n,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_cashflow_transactions."Internal Transfer") AS transfers
           FROM reporting_cashflow_transactions
          GROUP BY reporting_cashflow_transactions."Scope ID", reporting_cashflow_transactions."Date"
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT LEAST(min(l."Movement Date"), min((c."Cutover At" AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date), (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) AS first_date
           FROM "Cash Ledger" l
             FULL JOIN r008_cash_account_cutover c ON false
        ), days AS (
         SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month'::text, bounds.first_date::timestamp with time zone)::date::timestamp with time zone, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS d
           FROM bounds
        ), grid AS (
         SELECT s.scope,
            s.label,
            s.available,
            s.baseline,
            d.d,
            COALESCE(f.cash_in, 0::numeric) AS cash_in,
            COALESCE(f.cash_out, 0::numeric) AS cash_out,
            COALESCE(f.n, 0::bigint) AS n,
            COALESCE(f.transfers, 0::bigint) AS transfers
           FROM scopes s
             CROSS JOIN days d
             LEFT JOIN flows f ON f.scope = s.scope AND f.d = d.d
        ), running AS (
         SELECT grid.scope,
            grid.label,
            grid.available,
            grid.baseline,
            grid.d,
            grid.cash_in,
            grid.cash_out,
            grid.n,
            grid.transfers,
                CASE
                    WHEN grid.d >= grid.available THEN grid.baseline + sum(grid.cash_in - grid.cash_out) OVER (PARTITION BY grid.scope ORDER BY grid.d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS closing
           FROM grid
        )
 SELECT jsonb_build_array(scope, d)::text AS "Position ID",
    scope AS "Scope ID",
    label AS "Account",
    d AS "Date",
    closing - cash_in + cash_out AS "Opening Balance",
    cash_in AS "Money In",
    cash_out AS "Money Out",
    cash_in - cash_out AS "Net Movement",
    closing AS "Closing Balance",
    n AS "Transaction Count",
    transfers AS "Internal Transfer Count",
    available AS "Available From",
        CASE
            WHEN available IS NULL THEN 'Opening not initialized'::text
            WHEN d < available THEN 'Before known opening'::text
            ELSE 'Available'::text
        END AS "Balance Status"
   FROM running;

relations.name: reporting_charge_payment_health_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d,
            statement_timestamp() AS t
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT r."Ref Charges" AS id,
            r."Payment Date" AS effective_day,
            sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) AS p,
            sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) AS i
           FROM "Repayments" r
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE r."Payment Date" < ctx.d
          GROUP BY r."Ref Charges", r."Payment Date"
        ), running AS (
         SELECT daily.id,
            daily.effective_day,
            daily.p,
            daily.i,
            sum(daily.p) OVER (PARTITION BY daily.id ORDER BY daily.effective_day) AS cp,
            sum(daily.i) OVER (PARTITION BY daily.id ORDER BY daily.effective_day) AS ci
           FROM daily
        ), covered AS (
         SELECT r.id,
            r.effective_day,
            r.p,
            r.i,
            r.cp,
            r.ci,
            r.cp >= (c."Principal Due"::numeric - 0.005) AND r.ci >= (c."Interest Due"::numeric - 0.005) AS full_paid
           FROM running r
             JOIN "Charges" c ON c."Row ID" = r.id
        ), last_gap AS (
         SELECT covered.id,
            max(covered.effective_day) FILTER (WHERE NOT covered.full_paid) AS last_uncovered
           FROM covered
          GROUP BY covered.id
        ), timing AS (
         SELECT c.id,
            min(c.effective_day) FILTER (WHERE c.full_paid AND (g.last_uncovered IS NULL OR c.effective_day > g.last_uncovered)) AS settled
           FROM covered c
             JOIN last_gap g USING (id)
          GROUP BY c.id
        ), payments AS (
         SELECT r."Ref Charges" AS id,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS p,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS i,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= c."Charge Date" AND r."Payment Date" < ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS on_p,
            COALESCE(sum(r."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r."Payment Date" <= c."Charge Date" AND r."Payment Date" < ctx.d), 0::numeric) AS on_i,
            bool_or(r."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR r."Ref Loans" IS DISTINCT FROM c."Ref Loans") AS invalid
           FROM "Repayments" r
             JOIN "Charges" c ON c."Row ID" = r."Ref Charges"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          GROUP BY r."Ref Charges"
        ), base AS (
         SELECT c."Row ID" AS charge_id,
            c."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
            l."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            c."Charge Date" AS due_date,
            c."Principal Due"::numeric AS principal_due,
            c."Interest Due"::numeric AS interest_due,
            COALESCE(p.p, 0::numeric) AS principal_paid_current,
            COALESCE(p.i, 0::numeric) AS interest_paid_current,
            GREATEST(c."Principal Due"::numeric - COALESCE(p.p, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS principal_remaining_current,
            GREATEST(c."Interest Due"::numeric - COALESCE(p.i, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS interest_remaining_current,
            c."Charge Date" < ctx.d AND c."Principal Due"::numeric >= 0::numeric AND c."Interest Due"::numeric >= 0::numeric AND (c."Principal Due"::numeric + c."Interest Due"::numeric) > 0::numeric AS eligible,
            COALESCE(p.on_p, 0::numeric) >= (c."Principal Due"::numeric - 0.005) AND COALESCE(p.on_i, 0::numeric) >= (c."Interest Due"::numeric - 0.005) AS on_time_covered,
            tm.settled,
            GREATEST(COALESCE(tm.settled, ctx.d) - c."Charge Date", 0) AS late,
                CASE
                    WHEN c."Charge Date" IS NULL OR c."Principal Due" IS NULL OR c."Interest Due" IS NULL OR l."Row ID" IS NULL OR b."Row ID" IS NULL OR COALESCE(p.invalid, false) OR (c."Principal Due"::numeric < 0::numeric OR c."Interest Due"::numeric < 0::numeric) AND NOT COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) THEN 'Invalid source'::text
                    ELSE 'OK'::text
                END AS data_quality_status,
            COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) AS defaulted,
            ctx.d AS reporting_date,
            ctx.t AS calculated_at
           FROM "Charges" c
             LEFT JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c."Ref Loans"
             LEFT JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = l."Ref Borrowers"
             LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.id = c."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN timing tm ON tm.id = c."Row ID"
             CROSS JOIN ctx
        ), facts AS (
         SELECT base.charge_id,
            base.loan_id,
            base.borrower_id,
            base.due_date,
            base.principal_due,
            base.interest_due,
            base.principal_paid_current,
            base.interest_paid_current,
            base.principal_remaining_current,
            base.interest_remaining_current,
            base.eligible,
            base.on_time_covered,
            base.settled,
            base.late,
            base.data_quality_status,
            base.defaulted,
            base.reporting_date,
            base.calculated_at,
            COALESCE(base.eligible, false) AND base.data_quality_status = 'OK'::text AS history_eligible,
            base.principal_remaining_current + base.interest_remaining_current AS remaining_current,
                CASE
                    WHEN base.data_quality_status <> 'OK'::text THEN 'Invalid source'::text
                    WHEN base.principal_due < 0::numeric OR base.interest_due < 0::numeric THEN 'Default accounting'::text
                    WHEN (base.principal_due + base.interest_due) = 0::numeric THEN 'Zero obligation'::text
                    WHEN base.due_date >= base.reporting_date THEN 'Not matured'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS exclusion_reason
           FROM base
        ), overdue AS (
         SELECT facts.charge_id,
            facts.loan_id,
            facts.borrower_id,
            facts.due_date,
            facts.principal_due,
            facts.interest_due,
            facts.principal_paid_current,
            facts.interest_paid_current,
            facts.principal_remaining_current,
            facts.interest_remaining_current,
            facts.eligible,
            facts.on_time_covered,
            facts.settled,
            facts.late,
            facts.data_quality_status,
            facts.defaulted,
            facts.reporting_date,
            facts.calculated_at,
            facts.history_eligible,
            facts.remaining_current,
            facts.exclusion_reason,
            facts.history_eligible AND facts.remaining_current > 0.005 AS is_overdue
           FROM facts
        )
 SELECT charge_id,
    loan_id,
    borrower_id,
    due_date,
    principal_due,
    interest_due,
    history_eligible,
    exclusion_reason,
    data_quality_status,
    principal_paid_current,
    interest_paid_current,
        CASE
            WHEN data_quality_status = 'OK'::text THEN principal_remaining_current
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS principal_remaining_current,
        CASE
            WHEN data_quality_status = 'OK'::text THEN interest_remaining_current
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS interest_remaining_current,
        CASE
            WHEN data_quality_status = 'OK'::text THEN remaining_current
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS remaining_current,
    is_overdue,
        CASE
            WHEN data_quality_status <> 'OK'::text THEN NULL::numeric
            WHEN is_overdue THEN remaining_current
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS overdue_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN is_overdue THEN reporting_date - due_date
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS current_days_overdue,
        CASE
            WHEN history_eligible THEN on_time_covered
            ELSE NULL::boolean
        END AS on_time,
        CASE
            WHEN history_eligible THEN settled
            ELSE NULL::date
        END AS final_settlement_date,
        CASE
            WHEN history_eligible THEN late
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS historical_delay_days,
        CASE
            WHEN history_eligible THEN
            CASE
                WHEN late = 0 THEN 100
                WHEN late = 1 THEN 90
                WHEN late <= 3 THEN 70
                WHEN late <= 7 THEN 40
                ELSE 10
            END
            ELSE NULL::integer
        END AS delay_grade,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    'payment-health-v1'::text AS method_version
   FROM overdue;
