relations.name: reporting_forecast_context_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS reporting_date,
    statement_timestamp() AS calculated_at,
    c."Business Cash Held" AS current_cash,
    c."Cash Status" AS cash_status,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM "Repayments"
          WHERE "Repayments"."Payment Date" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Principal Paid" IS NULL) AS invalid_receipts,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM "Charges" c_1
             LEFT JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = c_1."Ref Loans"
          WHERE l."Row ID" IS NULL) AS orphan_charges
   FROM ( SELECT 1 AS "?column?") anchor
     LEFT JOIN reporting_cash_daily c ON c."Date" = olap_reporting_date();

relations.name: reporting_forecast_events_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT i.loan_id,
    i.borrower_id,
    i.borrower,
    i.loan_type,
    i.outstanding_principal,
    i.loan_status,
    i.defaulted,
    i.reporting_date,
    i.month_end,
    s.due_date,
    s.origin,
    s.bucket,
    s.principal,
    s.interest,
    s.eligible,
    s.issue
   FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL forecast_schedule_v1(i.loan, i.charges, i.reporting_date, i.month_end) s(due_date, origin, bucket, principal, interest, eligible, issue);

relations.name: reporting_forecast_inputs_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT existing.loan_id,
    existing.borrower_id,
    existing.borrower,
    existing.loan_type,
    existing.loan_status,
    existing.defaulted,
    existing.outstanding_principal,
    existing.reporting_date,
    existing.month_end,
    existing.loan || jsonb_build_object('original_rate', l."Original Daily Interest Rate") AS loan,
    existing.charges
   FROM ( WITH ctx AS (
                 SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS t
                ), repayments AS (
                 SELECT "Repayments"."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
                    COALESCE(sum("Repayments"."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE "Repayments"."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t), 0::numeric) AS principal,
                    bool_or("Repayments"."Payment Date" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR "Repayments"."Payment Date" > ctx_1.t) AS invalid
                   FROM "Repayments"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx ctx_1
                  GROUP BY "Repayments"."Ref Loans"
                ), paid AS (
                 SELECT r_1."Ref Charges" AS charge_id,
                    sum(r_1."Principal Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r_1."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t) AS p,
                    sum(r_1."Interest Paid"::numeric) FILTER (WHERE r_1."Payment Date" <= ctx_1.t) AS i,
                    bool_or(r_1."Payment Date" IS NULL OR r_1."Principal Paid" IS NULL OR r_1."Interest Paid" IS NULL OR r_1."Ref Loans" IS DISTINCT FROM c_1."Ref Loans") AS invalid
                   FROM "Repayments" r_1
                     LEFT JOIN "Charges" c_1 ON c_1."Row ID" = r_1."Ref Charges"
                     CROSS JOIN ctx ctx_1
                  GROUP BY r_1."Ref Charges"
                ), charges AS (
                 SELECT c_1."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
                    jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c_1."Row ID", 'date', c_1."Charge Date", 'pdue', c_1."Principal Due"::numeric, 'idue', c_1."Interest Due"::numeric, 'ppaid', COALESCE(p.p, 0::numeric), 'ipaid', COALESCE(p.i, 0::numeric), 'invalid', COALESCE(p.invalid, false) OR c_1."Charge Date" IS NULL OR c_1."Principal Due" IS NULL OR c_1."Interest Due" IS NULL)) AS charges
                   FROM "Charges" c_1
                     LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.charge_id = c_1."Row ID"
                  GROUP BY c_1."Ref Loans"
                )
         SELECT l_1."Row ID" AS loan_id,
            l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(b."Description", ''::text), b."Borrower Name", l_1."Ref Borrowers", 'Unmapped'::text) AS borrower,
                CASE l_1."Loan Type"
                    WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Interest'::text
                    WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN 'Fixed Due Date'::text
                    WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text
                    ELSE 'Unknown'::text
                END AS loan_type,
            l_1."Loan Status" AS loan_status,
            COALESCE(l_1."Defaulted", false) AS defaulted,
            l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric - COALESCE(r.principal, 0::numeric) AS outstanding_principal,
            ctx.t AS reporting_date,
            (date_trunc('month'::text, ctx.t::timestamp with time zone) + '1 mon -1 days'::interval)::date AS month_end,
            jsonb_build_object('status', l_1."Loan Status", 'defaulted', COALESCE(l_1."Defaulted", false), 'start', l_1."Loan Date", 'close', l_1."Close Date", 'balance', l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric - COALESCE(r.principal, 0::numeric), 'daily', l_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric, 'auto', l_1."Auto Charge Enabled", 'interval', l_1."Interest Payment Interval", 'anchor', l_1."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", 'type', l_1."Loan Type", 'due', l_1."Due Date", 'arrangement', l_1."Loan Arrangement", 'original', l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric, 'payment', l_1."Daily Payment Amount"::numeric, 'fixed', l_1."Fixed Interest"::numeric, 'invalid', l_1."Loan Date" IS NULL OR l_1."Principal Amount" IS NULL OR b."Row ID" IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.invalid, false)) AS loan,
            COALESCE(c.charges, '[]'::jsonb) AS charges
           FROM "Loans" l_1
             LEFT JOIN "Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID" = l_1."Ref Borrowers"
             LEFT JOIN repayments r ON r.loan_id = l_1."Row ID"
             LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.loan_id = l_1."Row ID"
             CROSS JOIN ctx) existing
     JOIN "Loans" l ON l."Row ID" = existing.loan_id;

relations.name: reporting_forecast_loans_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ev AS (
         SELECT reporting_forecast_events_v1.loan_id,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND (reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = ANY (ARRAY['Today'::text, 'Future'::text]))), 0::numeric) AS ui,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.principal) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND (reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = ANY (ARRAY['Today'::text, 'Future'::text]))), 0::numeric) AS up,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = 'Overdue'::text), 0::numeric) AS oi,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.principal) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = 'Overdue'::text), 0::numeric) AS op,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text), 0::numeric) AS xi,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.principal) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = 'Recovery only'::text), 0::numeric) AS xp,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND (reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = ANY (ARRAY['Today'::text, 'Future'::text])) AND reporting_forecast_events_v1.origin = 'Recorded'::text), 0::numeric) AS recorded_interest,
            COALESCE(sum(reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.origin = 'Simulated'::text), 0::numeric) AS simulated_interest,
            min(reporting_forecast_events_v1.due_date) FILTER (WHERE reporting_forecast_events_v1.eligible AND (reporting_forecast_events_v1.bucket = ANY (ARRAY['Today'::text, 'Future'::text])) AND (reporting_forecast_events_v1.principal + reporting_forecast_events_v1.interest) > 0::numeric) AS next_due,
            bool_or(reporting_forecast_events_v1.origin = 'Exception'::text) AS incomplete,
            string_agg(DISTINCT reporting_forecast_events_v1.issue, '; '::text ORDER BY reporting_forecast_events_v1.issue) AS issues
           FROM reporting_forecast_events_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_forecast_events_v1.loan_id
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT reporting_forecast_actuals_v1.loan_id,
            sum(reporting_forecast_actuals_v1.interest) AS actual_interest
           FROM reporting_forecast_actuals_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_forecast_actuals_v1.loan_id
        )
 SELECT i.loan_id,
    i.borrower_id,
    i.borrower,
    i.loan_type,
    i.loan_status,
    i.defaulted,
    i.outstanding_principal,
    i.reporting_date,
    i.month_end,
    COALESCE(e.ui, 0::numeric) AS ui,
    COALESCE(e.up, 0::numeric) AS up,
    COALESCE(e.oi, 0::numeric) AS oi,
    COALESCE(e.op, 0::numeric) AS op,
    COALESCE(e.xi, 0::numeric) AS xi,
    COALESCE(e.xp, 0::numeric) AS xp,
    COALESCE(e.recorded_interest, 0::numeric) AS recorded_interest,
    COALESCE(e.simulated_interest, 0::numeric) AS simulated_interest,
    COALESCE(a.actual_interest, 0::numeric) AS actual_interest,
    e.next_due,
    COALESCE(e.incomplete, false) AS incomplete,
    e.issues,
    COALESCE(h.arrangement_status, 'Not assessed'::text) AS arrangement_status
   FROM reporting_forecast_inputs_v1 i
     LEFT JOIN ev e USING (loan_id)
     LEFT JOIN actual a USING (loan_id)
     LEFT JOIN reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1 h USING (loan_id);

relations.name: reporting_income_daily
relations.definition:
WITH income AS (
         SELECT olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" AS d,
            sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric) AS income,
            sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit") AS pa,
            sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit") AS pb
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics
          WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date"
        ), expenses AS (
         SELECT "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" AS d,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric) AS expense,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Partner A Expense"::numeric) AS pa,
            sum("Business Expenses"."Partner B Expense"::numeric) AS pb
           FROM "Business Expenses"
          WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY "Business Expenses"."Expense Date"
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT unnamed_subquery."Transfer Date" AS d,
            COALESCE(sum(unnamed_subquery."Amount") FILTER (WHERE unnamed_subquery."Partner Role" = 'A'::text), 0::numeric) AS pa,
            COALESCE(sum(unnamed_subquery."Amount") FILTER (WHERE unnamed_subquery."Partner Role" = 'B'::text), 0::numeric) AS pb
           FROM ( SELECT s."Row ID" AS "Settlement ID",
                    s."Ref Partner" AS "Partner ID",
                    p."Partner Name" AS "Partner",
                    p."Partner Role",
                    s."Transfer Date",
                    s."Amount"::numeric AS "Amount",
                    s."Status"
                   FROM "Settlements" s
                     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
                  WHERE s."Transfer Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) unnamed_subquery
          WHERE unnamed_subquery."Status" = 'Completed'::text
          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery."Transfer Date"
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT min(dates.d) AS first_date
           FROM ( SELECT income.d
                   FROM income
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT expenses.d
                   FROM expenses
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT settled.d
                   FROM settled) dates
        ), calendar AS (
         SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month'::text, COALESCE(bounds.first_date, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date)::timestamp with time zone)::date::timestamp with time zone, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS d
           FROM bounds
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT c.d,
            COALESCE(i.income, 0::numeric) AS income,
            COALESCE(e.expense, 0::numeric) AS expense,
            COALESCE(i.pa, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.pa, 0::numeric) AS pa_net,
            COALESCE(i.pb, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.pb, 0::numeric) AS pb_net,
            COALESCE(s.pa, 0::numeric) AS pa_settled,
            COALESCE(s.pb, 0::numeric) AS pb_settled
           FROM calendar c
             LEFT JOIN income i USING (d)
             LEFT JOIN expenses e USING (d)
             LEFT JOIN settled s USING (d)
        )
 SELECT d AS "Date",
    date_trunc('month'::text, d::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Month",
    income AS "Operating Income",
    expense AS "Expenses",
    - expense AS "Signed Expenses",
    income - expense AS "Net Profit",
    pa_net AS "Partner A Net Profit",
    pb_net AS "Partner B Net Profit",
    COALESCE(sum(pa_net) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0::numeric) AS "Prior Partner A Net",
    COALESCE(sum(pb_net) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0::numeric) AS "Prior Partner B Net",
    sum(pa_settled) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Partner A Settled Through Date",
    sum(pb_settled) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Partner B Settled Through Date",
    sum(income - expense) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS "Net Profit Through Date"
   FROM daily;

relations.name: reporting_income_events
relations.definition:
SELECT 'repayment:'::text || olap_repayments_analytics."Row ID" AS "Event ID",
    olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" AS "Date",
    olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Income",
    0::numeric AS "Expenses"
   FROM olap_repayments_analytics
  WHERE olap_repayments_analytics."Payment Date" <= olap_reporting_date()
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'expense:'::text || "Business Expenses"."Row ID" AS "Event ID",
    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" AS "Date",
    0::numeric AS "Income",
    "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Expenses"
   FROM "Business Expenses"
  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= olap_reporting_date();

relations.name: reporting_income_monthly
relations.definition:
WITH income AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, unnamed_subquery."Payment Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS period_month,
            sum(unnamed_subquery."Interest Paid") AS amount
           FROM ( WITH context AS (
                         SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS today
                        )
                 SELECT r."Row ID" AS "Repayment ID",
                    r."Ref Loans" AS "Loan ID",
                    l."Borrower ID",
                    l."Borrower",
                    l."Hidden",
                    l."Loan Type",
                    r."Payment Date",
                    r."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Interest Paid",
                    r."Principal Paid"::numeric AS "Principal Paid",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest 30D",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 6) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest Recent 7D",
                        CASE
                            WHEN r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 14) AND r."Payment Date" <= (c.today - 8) THEN r."Interest Paid"::numeric
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS "Interest Prior 7D",
                    r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today AS "In Last 30 Days"
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l_1."Row ID" AS "Loan ID",
                            l_1."Ref Borrowers" AS "Borrower ID",
                            b."Borrower",
                            b."Hidden",
                            l_1."Loan Date",
                                CASE l_1."Loan Type"
                                    WHEN 'กำหนดวันชำระ'::text THEN 'Fixed Due Date'::text
                                    WHEN 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Interest'::text
                                    WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text
                                    ELSE 'Unknown'::text
                                END AS "Loan Type",
                            l_1."Loan Type" AS "Loan Type Thai",
                            l_1."Outstanding Principal",
                            l_1."Principal Amount"::numeric AS "Principal Amount",
                            l_1."Close Date",
                            l_1."Due Date",
                                CASE l_1."Loan Status"
                                    WHEN 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text THEN 'Closed'::text
                                    WHEN 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text THEN 'Active'::text
                                    ELSE l_1."Loan Status"
                                END AS "Loan Status",
                            l_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric AS "Current Daily Interest",
                            l_1."Expected Interest This Month",
                            l_1."Total Interest Received",
                            l_1."Total Principal Received",
                            l_1."Loan Age Days",
                            l_1."Loan Age Bucket",
                            l_1."Defaulted Flag",
                            l_1."Default Loss Amount"::numeric AS "Default Loss Amount",
                            date_trunc('week'::text, l_1."Loan Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Loan Week"
                           FROM olap_loans_analytics l_1
                             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b_1."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",
                                    b_1."Description" AS "Borrower",
                                    b_1."Creation Date" AS "Created Date",
                                    b_1."Hidden Flag" AS "Hidden",
                                    b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" AS "Outstanding Principal",
                                    b_1."Active Loan Count" AS "Active Loans",
                                    b_1."Overdue Amount",
                                    b_1."Has Active Loan",
                                    b_1."Total Interest Earned",
                                    b_1."Total Number of Loans",
                                    b_1."Return on Active Principal",
                                    b_1."Profit Last 30 Days",
                                    b_1."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
                                    b_1."30D Return on Average Principal",
                                    b_1."Daily Collection Status",
                                    b_1."Todays Amount Due",
                                    b_1."Todays Amount Collected",
                                    b_1."Todays Amount Remaining",
                                    b_1."Portfolio Exposure %",
                                    b_1."Oldest Active Loan Age",
                                    b_1."Historical Charge Count",
                                    b_1."Lifetime On Time Rate",
                                    b_1."Recent 30D On Time Rate",
                                    b_1."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
                                    b_1."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
                                    b_1."Maximum Days Late",
                                    b_1."Last Late Payment Date",
                                    b_1."Largest Successful Loan",
                                    b_1."Average Successful Loan Size",
                                    b_1."Default Count",
                                    b_1."Lifetime Default Loss",
                                    b_1."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
                                    b_1."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
                                    b_1."Matrix Economic Contribution",
                                    b_1."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
                                    b_1."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
                                    b_1."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
                                    b_1."Matrix Current Condition Score",
                                    b_1."Matrix History Sufficient",
                                    b_1."Matrix Stability Score",
                                    b_1."Matrix Quadrant",
                                    b_1."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
                                    (b_1."Description" || ' · '::text) || COALESCE(b_1."Matrix Quadrant", 'Unclassified'::text) AS "Matrix Label",
                                    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" DESC NULLS LAST, b_1."Row ID") AS "Principal Rank",
                                    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM olap_loans_analytics l_2
  WHERE l_2."Ref Borrowers" = b_1."Row ID" AND l_2."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text)) AS "Has Closed Loan"
                                   FROM olap_borrowers_analytics b_1) b ON b."Borrower ID" = l_1."Ref Borrowers") l ON l."Loan ID" = r."Ref Loans"
                     CROSS JOIN context c) unnamed_subquery
          WHERE unnamed_subquery."Payment Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, unnamed_subquery."Payment Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date)
        ), expenses AS (
         SELECT unnamed_subquery."Expense Month" AS period_month,
            sum(unnamed_subquery."Expense Amount") AS amount
           FROM ( SELECT "Business Expenses"."Row ID" AS "Expense ID",
                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date",
                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Category",
                    "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Expense Amount",
                    - "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Statement Expense",
                    date_trunc('month'::text, "Business Expenses"."Expense Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Expense Month",
                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS "In Current Month"
                   FROM "Business Expenses"
                  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) unnamed_subquery
          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery."Expense Month"
        ), bounds AS (
         SELECT min(dates.period_month) AS first_month
           FROM ( SELECT income.period_month
                   FROM income
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT expenses.period_month
                   FROM expenses) dates
        ), months AS (
         SELECT generate_series(COALESCE(bounds.first_month, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date)::timestamp with time zone, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 mon'::interval)::date AS period_month
           FROM bounds
        )
 SELECT m.period_month AS "Month",
    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Operating Income",
    COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Expenses",
    - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Signed Expenses",
    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Net Profit",
    (COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Net Margin",
    m.period_month = date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AS "Is Current Month",
        CASE
            WHEN m.period_month = date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date THEN 'Month to date'::text
            ELSE 'Full month'::text
        END AS "Period Coverage",
    m.period_month >= (date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)) - '11 mons'::interval)::date AS "In Last 12 Months"
   FROM months m
     LEFT JOIN income i USING (period_month)
     LEFT JOIN expenses e USING (period_month);

relations.name: reporting_income_statement
relations.definition:
SELECT "Row ID" AS "Statement ID",
    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS "As Of Date",
    date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AS "Month Start",
    to_char((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text), 'FMMonth YYYY'::text) AS "Statement Month",
    "Operating Income MTD",
    "Expenses MTD",
    "Net Profit MTD",
    "Tommy Withdrawn MTD",
    "Lisa Withdrawn MTD",
    "Unsettled Profit MTD",
    "Cash Pool Remaining",
    "Business Cash Held",
    "Net Profit MTD" / NULLIF("Operating Income MTD", 0::numeric) AS "Net Margin",
    - ("Tommy Withdrawn MTD" + "Lisa Withdrawn MTD") AS "Partner Draws MTD",
    "Business Cash Held" - "Cash Pool Remaining" - "Unsettled Profit MTD" AS "Cash Reconciliation Difference",
    ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(unnamed_subquery."Net Profit"), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
           FROM ( WITH income AS (
                         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, unnamed_subquery_1."Payment Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS period_month,
                            sum(unnamed_subquery_1."Interest Paid") AS amount
                           FROM ( WITH context AS (
 SELECT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS today
)
                                 SELECT r."Row ID" AS "Repayment ID",
                                    r."Ref Loans" AS "Loan ID",
                                    l."Borrower ID",
                                    l."Borrower",
                                    l."Hidden",
                                    l."Loan Type",
                                    r."Payment Date",
                                    r."Interest Paid"::numeric AS "Interest Paid",
                                    r."Principal Paid"::numeric AS "Principal Paid",
CASE

END AS "Interest 30D",

END AS "Interest Prior 7D",
                                    r."Payment Date" >= (c.today - 29) AND r."Payment Date" <= c.today AS "In Last 30 Days"

   WHEN 'ผ่อนชำระรายวัน'::text THEN 'Daily Installment'::text

  END AS "Loan Status",
    l_1."Current Daily Interest"::numeric AS "Current Daily Interest",

    date_trunc('week'::text, l_1."Loan Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Loan Week"
   FROM olap_loans_analytics l_1
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b_1."Row ID" AS "Borrower ID",
      b_1."Description" AS "Borrower",

      b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" AS "Outstanding Principal",
      b_1."Active Loan Count" AS "Active Loans",
      b_1."Overdue Amount",
      b_1."Has Active Loan",
      b_1."Total Interest Earned",
      b_1."Total Number of Loans",
      b_1."Return on Active Principal",
      b_1."Profit Last 30 Days",
      b_1."30D Average Outstanding Principal",
      b_1."30D Return on Average Principal",
      b_1."Daily Collection Status",
      b_1."Todays Amount Due",
      b_1."Todays Amount Collected",
      b_1."Todays Amount Remaining",
      b_1."Portfolio Exposure %",
      b_1."Oldest Active Loan Age",
      b_1."Historical Charge Count",
      b_1."Lifetime On Time Rate",
      b_1."Recent 30D On Time Rate",
      b_1."Lifetime Late Payment Count",
      b_1."Recent 30D Late Payment Count",
      b_1."Maximum Days Late",
      b_1."Last Late Payment Date",
      b_1."Largest Successful Loan",
      b_1."Average Successful Loan Size",
      b_1."Default Count",
      b_1."Lifetime Default Loss",
      b_1."Portfolio Outstanding Principal",
      b_1."Projected Monthly Profit Contribution",
      b_1."Matrix Economic Contribution",
      b_1."Matrix Recent Reliability Score",
      b_1."Matrix Historical Reliability Score",
      b_1."Matrix Delay Severity Score",
      b_1."Matrix Current Condition Score",
      b_1."Matrix History Sufficient",
      b_1."Matrix Stability Score",
      b_1."Matrix Quadrant",
      b_1."Matrix Scaled Economic Contribution",
      (b_1."Description" || ' · '::text) || COALESCE(b_1."Matrix Quadrant", 'Unclassified'::text) AS "Matrix Label",
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY b_1."Total Outstanding Principal" DESC NULLS LAST, b_1."Row ID") AS "Principal Rank",
      (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
       FROM olap_loans_analytics l_2
      WHERE l_2."Ref Borrowers" = b_1."Row ID" AND l_2."Loan Status" = 'ปิดยอดแล้ว'::text)) AS "Has Closed Loan"
     FROM olap_borrowers_analytics b_1) b ON b."Borrower ID" = l_1."Ref Borrowers") l ON l."Loan ID" = r."Ref Loans"
                                     CROSS JOIN context c) unnamed_subquery_1
                          WHERE unnamed_subquery_1."Payment Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date
                          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, unnamed_subquery_1."Payment Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date)
                        ), expenses AS (
                         SELECT unnamed_subquery_1."Expense Month" AS period_month,
                            sum(unnamed_subquery_1."Expense Amount") AS amount
                           FROM ( SELECT "Business Expenses"."Row ID" AS "Expense ID",
                                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date",
                                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Category",
                                    "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Expense Amount",
                                    - "Business Expenses"."Amount"::numeric AS "Statement Expense",
                                    date_trunc('month'::text, "Business Expenses"."Expense Date"::timestamp with time zone)::date AS "Expense Month",
                                    "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" >= date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AND "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date AS "In Current Month"
                                   FROM "Business Expenses"
                                  WHERE "Business Expenses"."Expense Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date) unnamed_subquery_1
                          GROUP BY unnamed_subquery_1."Expense Month"
                        ), bounds AS (
                         SELECT min(dates.period_month) AS first_month
                           FROM ( SELECT income.period_month
                                   FROM income
                                UNION ALL
                                 SELECT expenses.period_month
                                   FROM expenses) dates
                        ), months AS (
                         SELECT generate_series(COALESCE(bounds.first_month, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date)::timestamp with time zone, date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date::timestamp with time zone, '1 mon'::interval)::date AS period_month
                           FROM bounds
                        )
                 SELECT m.period_month AS "Month",
                    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Operating Income",
                    COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Expenses",
                    - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Signed Expenses",
                    COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Net Profit",
                    (COALESCE(i.amount, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amount, 0::numeric)) / NULLIF(i.amount, 0::numeric) AS "Net Margin",
                    m.period_month = date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date AS "Is Current Month",
                        CASE
                            WHEN m.period_month = date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text))::date THEN 'Month to date'::text
                            ELSE 'Full month'::text
                        END AS "Period Coverage",
                    m.period_month >= (date_trunc('month'::text, (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)) - '11 mons'::interval)::date AS "In Last 12 Months"
                   FROM months m
                     LEFT JOIN income i USING (period_month)
                     LEFT JOIN expenses e USING (period_month)) unnamed_subquery) AS "Net Profit Since Inception",
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM ( SELECT "Cash Account Balances"."Ref Cash Account" AS "Cash Account ID",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Ref Cash Holder" AS "Cash Holder ID",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Holder Name" AS "Cash Holder",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Account Label" AS "Account",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Current Balance",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Initialized",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Business Cash Held",
                    "Cash Account Balances"."Reimbursement / Advance Due" AS "Advance Due",
                        CASE
                            WHEN bool_and("Cash Account Balances"."Initialized") OVER (PARTITION BY "Cash Account Balances"."Ref Cash Holder") THEN "Cash Account Balances"."Business Cash Held"
                            ELSE NULL::numeric
                        END AS "Holder Cash Component",
                        CASE
                            WHEN "Cash Account Balances"."Initialized" THEN 'Known'::text
                            ELSE 'Opening balance missing'::text
                        END AS "Balance Status"
                   FROM "Cash Account Balances") unnamed_subquery
          WHERE NOT unnamed_subquery."Initialized") AS "Uninitialized Accounts",
        CASE
            WHEN "Business Cash Held" IS NULL THEN 'Account opening balance missing'::text
            WHEN abs("Business Cash Held" - "Cash Pool Remaining" - "Unsettled Profit MTD") < 0.005 THEN 'Reconciled'::text
            ELSE 'Review difference'::text
        END AS "Cash Reconciliation Status"
   FROM "Cash Dashboard" s;

relations.name: reporting_loan_schedule_health_v1
relations.definition:
WITH ctx AS (
         SELECT olap_reporting_date() AS d,
            statement_timestamp() AS t
        ), charge_dates AS (
         SELECT "Charges"."Ref Loans" AS loan_id,
            "Charges"."Charge Date" AS due_date,
            sum("Charges"."Interest Due"::numeric) AS interest,
            sum("Charges"."Principal Due"::numeric) AS principal,
            bool_or("Charges"."Charge Date" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Interest Due" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Principal Due" IS NULL OR "Charges"."Interest Due"::numeric < 0::numeric OR "Charges"."Principal Due"::numeric < 0::numeric) AS invalid
           FROM "Charges"
          GROUP BY "Charges"."Ref Loans", "Charges"."Charge Date"
        ), base AS (
         SELECT l."Row ID" AS loan_id,
            l."Ref Borrowers" AS borrower_id,
            l."Loan Type" AS loan_type,
            l."Loan Date" AS start_date,
            COALESCE(l."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", l."Loan Date") AS anchor_date,
            l."Interest Payment Interval" AS payment_interval,
            l."Current Daily Interest"::numeric AS daily_interest,
            COALESCE(l."Transfer Fee"::numeric, 0::numeric) AS transfer_fee,
            COALESCE(l."Auto Charge Enabled", false) AS auto_charge_enabled,
            l."Outstanding Principal" AS outstanding_principal,
            COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) AS defaulted,
            ctx.d AS reporting_date,
            ctx.t AS calculated_at,
                CASE
                    WHEN l."Loan Type" IS DISTINCT FROM 'ดอกเบี้ยรายวัน'::text THEN 'Unsupported loan type'::text
                    WHEN l."Loan Date" IS NULL OR l."Interest Payment Interval" IS NULL OR l."Interest Payment Interval" < 1 OR l."Current Daily Interest" IS NULL OR l."Current Daily Interest"::numeric <= 0::numeric OR COALESCE(l."Interest Schedule Anchor Date", l."Loan Date") < l."Loan Date" OR COALESCE(l."Defaulted", false) THEN 'Source review'::text
                    ELSE 'Supported'::text
                END AS setup_status
           FROM "Loans" l
             CROSS JOIN ctx
          WHERE l."Loan Status" = 'ยังไม่ปิดยอด'::text AND (l."Loan Date" <= ctx.d OR l."Loan Date" IS NULL) AND (l."Close Date" IS NULL OR l."Close Date" > ctx.d)
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,
            b.transfer_fee,
            b.auto_charge_enabled,
            b.outstanding_principal,
            b.defaulted,
            b.reporting_date,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.setup_status,
            GREATEST(b.reporting_date - 30,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.anchor_date > b.start_date THEN b.anchor_date + 1
                    ELSE b.start_date
                END) AS comparison_start,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.anchor_date > b.start_date THEN COALESCE(( SELECT max(c.due_date) AS max
                       FROM charge_dates c
                      WHERE c.loan_id = b.loan_id AND c.due_date <= b.anchor_date), b.start_date)
                    ELSE b.start_date
                END AS accrual_baseline
           FROM base b
        ), expected_dates AS (
         SELECT dates.loan_id,
            dates.start_date AS due_date,
            dates.daily_interest AS amount
           FROM dates
          WHERE dates.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND dates.anchor_date = dates.start_date AND dates.start_date >= dates.comparison_start AND dates.start_date < dates.reporting_date
        UNION ALL
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.anchor_date + n.n * b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest *
                CASE
                    WHEN n.n = 1 THEN b.anchor_date + b.payment_interval - b.accrual_baseline
                    ELSE b.payment_interval
                END::numeric
           FROM dates b
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(GREATEST(1, ceil((b.comparison_start - b.anchor_date)::numeric / NULLIF(b.payment_interval, 0)::numeric)::integer), floor((b.reporting_date - 1 - b.anchor_date)::numeric / NULLIF(b.payment_interval, 0)::numeric)::integer) n(n)
          WHERE b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text
        ), expected AS (
         SELECT expected_dates.loan_id,
            sum(expected_dates.amount) AS expected_interest_30d,
            count(*)::integer AS expected_due_dates_30d
           FROM expected_dates
          GROUP BY expected_dates.loan_id
        ), actual AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            COALESCE(sum(c.interest -
                CASE
                    WHEN c.due_date = b.start_date THEN b.transfer_fee
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date), 0::numeric) AS recorded_interest_30d,
            COALESCE(sum(c.principal) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date), 0::numeric) AS recorded_principal_30d,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.comparison_start AND c.due_date < b.reporting_date AND (c.interest -
                CASE
                    WHEN c.due_date = b.start_date THEN b.transfer_fee
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) > 0::numeric)::integer AS recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            max(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date < b.reporting_date) AS last_recorded_due_date,
            min(c.due_date) FILTER (WHERE c.due_date >= b.reporting_date AND c.due_date < (b.reporting_date + 90)) AS next_plan_due_date,
            bool_or(c.invalid OR c.due_date = b.start_date AND c.interest < b.transfer_fee) AS source_invalid
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates c USING (loan_id)
          GROUP BY b.loan_id
        ), metrics AS (
         SELECT b.loan_id,
            b.borrower_id,
            b.loan_type,
            b.start_date,
            b.anchor_date,
            b.payment_interval,
            b.daily_interest,
            b.transfer_fee,
            b.auto_charge_enabled,
            b.outstanding_principal,
            b.defaulted,
            b.reporting_date,
            b.calculated_at,
            b.setup_status,
            b.comparison_start,
            b.accrual_baseline,
            GREATEST(0, b.reporting_date - b.comparison_start) AS observation_days,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN COALESCE(e.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expected_interest_30d,
                CASE
                    WHEN b.setup_status = 'Supported'::text AND NOT COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN a.recorded_interest_30d
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS recorded_interest_30d,
            a.recorded_principal_30d,
            COALESCE(e.expected_due_dates_30d, 0) AS expected_due_dates_30d,
            a.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            a.last_recorded_due_date,
            a.next_plan_due_date,
            f.interest AS next_plan_interest,
            f.principal AS next_plan_principal,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.source_invalid, false) THEN 'Source review'::text
                    ELSE b.setup_status
                END AS comparison_status
           FROM dates b
             LEFT JOIN expected e USING (loan_id)
             JOIN actual a USING (loan_id)
             LEFT JOIN charge_dates f ON f.loan_id = b.loan_id AND f.due_date = a.next_plan_due_date
        ), ratios AS (
         SELECT metrics.loan_id,
            metrics.borrower_id,
            metrics.loan_type,
            metrics.start_date,
            metrics.anchor_date,
            metrics.payment_interval,
            metrics.daily_interest,
            metrics.transfer_fee,
            metrics.auto_charge_enabled,
            metrics.outstanding_principal,
            metrics.defaulted,
            metrics.reporting_date,
            metrics.calculated_at,
            metrics.setup_status,
            metrics.comparison_start,
            metrics.accrual_baseline,
            metrics.observation_days,
            metrics.expected_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d,
            metrics.recorded_principal_30d,
            metrics.expected_due_dates_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d,
            metrics.last_recorded_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_due_date,
            metrics.next_plan_interest,
            metrics.next_plan_principal,
            metrics.comparison_status,
            metrics.recorded_interest_30d / NULLIF(metrics.expected_interest_30d, 0::numeric) AS interest_coverage_30d,
            metrics.recorded_interest_dates_30d::numeric / NULLIF(metrics.expected_due_dates_30d, 0)::numeric AS interest_date_coverage_30d,
            metrics.comparison_status = 'Supported'::text AND metrics.observation_days >= 7 AND metrics.expected_due_dates_30d >= 2 AS assessment_eligible
           FROM metrics
        )
 SELECT loan_id,
    borrower_id,
    loan_type,
    start_date,
    anchor_date,
    payment_interval,
    daily_interest,
    transfer_fee,
    auto_charge_enabled,
    outstanding_principal,
    defaulted,
    reporting_date,
    calculated_at,
    setup_status,
    comparison_start,
    accrual_baseline,
    observation_days,
    expected_interest_30d,
    recorded_interest_30d,
    recorded_principal_30d,
    expected_due_dates_30d,
    recorded_interest_dates_30d,
    last_recorded_due_date,
    next_plan_due_date,
    next_plan_interest,
    next_plan_principal,
    comparison_status,
    interest_coverage_30d,
    interest_date_coverage_30d,
    assessment_eligible,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8), false) AS schedule_departure,
    COALESCE(assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled, false) AS modified_schedule,
        CASE
            WHEN assessment_eligible AND (interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 OR interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8) AND NOT auto_charge_enabled THEN 'Modified payment schedule'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'Insufficient observation'::text
            ELSE 'No schedule restriction'::text
        END AS arrangement_status,
        CASE
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest and fewer charge dates'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Reduced/deferred interest'::text
            WHEN NOT auto_charge_enabled AND assessment_eligible AND interest_date_coverage_30d < 0.8 THEN 'Fewer charge dates / deferred payment frequency'::text
            WHEN comparison_status <> 'Supported'::text THEN comparison_status
            WHEN NOT assessment_eligible THEN 'At least seven observed days and two expected dates required'::text
            ELSE 'Automatic schedule rule does not restrict category'::text
        END AS schedule_reason,
    'schedule-health-v1'::text AS schedule_method_version
   FROM ratios;

relations.name: reporting_partner_capital_ledger_v1
relations.definition:
WITH dated AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS movement
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date
        ), balances AS (
         SELECT dated.partner_id,
            dated.activity_date,
            sum(dated.movement) OVER (PARTITION BY dated.partner_id ORDER BY dated.activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS date_end_capital
           FROM dated
        )
 SELECT c.capital_id,
    c.partner_id,
    c.partner_name,
    c.partner_role,
    c.activity_date,
    c.transaction_type,
    c.amount,
    c.net_movement,
    c.valid,
    b.date_end_capital
   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1 c
     LEFT JOIN balances b USING (partner_id, activity_date);

relations.name: reporting_partner_capital_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT c."Row ID" AS capital_id,
    c."Ref Partner" AS partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    p."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
    c."Contribution Date" AS activity_date,
    c."Transaction Type" AS transaction_type,
    c."Amount"::numeric AS amount,
        CASE
            WHEN c."Transaction Type" = 'Contribution'::text THEN c."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE - c."Amount"::numeric
        END AS net_movement,
    ((p."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])) AND c."Amount" IS NOT NULL AND c."Contribution Date" IS NOT NULL AND (c."Transaction Type" = ANY (ARRAY['Contribution'::text, 'Withdrawal'::text]))) IS TRUE AS valid
   FROM "Cash Pool Contributions" c
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = c."Ref Partner";

relations.name: reporting_partner_daily_v1
relations.definition:
WITH bounds AS (
         SELECT LEAST(COALESCE(min(x.d), olap_reporting_date()), olap_reporting_date()) AS starts
           FROM ( SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date AS d
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date
                   FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
                UNION ALL
                 SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1) x
        ), dates AS (
         SELECT generate_series(bounds.starts::timestamp with time zone, olap_reporting_date()::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS activity_date
           FROM bounds
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.amount) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.transaction_type = 'Contribution'::text) AS contributed,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.amount) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_capital_v1.transaction_type = 'Withdrawal'::text) AS withdrawn,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS movement
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date
        ), earnings AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_interest) AS interest,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_expense) AS expense
           FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date
        ), settled AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id,
            reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.completed_amount) AS completed
           FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id, reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date
        ), daily AS (
         SELECT p.partner_id,
            p.partner_name,
            d_1.activity_date,
            p.ready,
            p.capital_exceptions,
            p.earnings_exceptions,
            p.settlement_exceptions,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 AND p.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND p.role_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(e.interest, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS allocated_interest,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 AND p.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND p.role_count = 1 THEN COALESCE(e.expense, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS allocated_expense,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.settlement_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(s.completed, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS completed_payouts,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.contributed, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_contributed,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.withdrawn, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_withdrawn,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.movement, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_movement
           FROM reporting_partner_position_v1 p
             CROSS JOIN dates d_1
             LEFT JOIN capital c USING (partner_id, activity_date)
             LEFT JOIN earnings e USING (partner_id, activity_date)
             LEFT JOIN settled s USING (partner_id, activity_date)
        )
 SELECT partner_id,
    partner_name,
    activity_date,
    ready,
    capital_exceptions,
    earnings_exceptions,
    settlement_exceptions,
    allocated_interest,
    allocated_expense,
    completed_payouts,
    capital_contributed,
    capital_withdrawn,
    capital_movement,
    allocated_interest - allocated_expense AS net_earned,
        CASE
            WHEN capital_exceptions = 0 THEN sum(capital_movement) OVER (PARTITION BY partner_id ORDER BY activity_date ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS capital_eod
   FROM daily d;

relations.name: reporting_partner_earnings_v1
relations.definition:
WITH mapping AS (
         SELECT "Partners"."Partner Role" AS role,
            min("Partners"."Row ID") AS partner_id
           FROM "Partners"
          WHERE "Partners"."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])
          GROUP BY "Partners"."Partner Role"
         HAVING count(*) = 1
        ), events AS (
         SELECT 'Interest'::text AS event_type,
            r."Row ID" AS event_id,
            r."Payment Date" AS activity_date,
            v.role,
            v.amount AS allocated_interest,
            0::numeric AS allocated_expense,
            r."Interest Paid" IS NOT NULL AS amount_known
           FROM olap_repayments_analytics r
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('A'::text,r."Partner A Profit"), ('B'::text,r."Partner B Profit")) v(role, amount)
        UNION ALL
         SELECT 'Expense'::text,
            e_1."Row ID",
            e_1."Expense Date",
            v.role,
            0::numeric AS "numeric",
            v.amount,
            e_1."Amount" IS NOT NULL
           FROM "Business Expenses" e_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES ('A'::text,e_1."Partner A Expense"::numeric), ('B'::text,e_1."Partner B Expense"::numeric)) v(role, amount)
        )
 SELECT e.event_type,
    e.event_id,
    e.activity_date,
    e.role,
    e.allocated_interest,
    e.allocated_expense,
    e.amount_known,
    m.partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    e.allocated_interest - e.allocated_expense AS net_earned,
    m.partner_id IS NOT NULL AND e.activity_date IS NOT NULL AND e.amount_known AND e.allocated_interest IS NOT NULL AND e.allocated_expense IS NOT NULL AS valid
   FROM events e
     LEFT JOIN mapping m ON m.role = e.role
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = m.partner_id;

relations.name: reporting_partner_position_v1
relations.definition:
WITH partners AS (
         SELECT "Partners"."Row ID" AS partner_id,
            "Partners"."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
            "Partners"."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY "Partners"."Partner Role") AS role_count
           FROM "Partners"
          WHERE "Partners"."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])
        ), capital AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement) AS net_capital,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_capital_v1.partner_id
        ), earnings AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_interest) AS interest_earned,
            sum(reporting_partner_earnings_v1.allocated_expense) AS expenses,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_earnings_v1.partner_id
        ), settlements AS (
         SELECT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.completed_amount) AS completed,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.pending_amount) AS pending,
            sum(reporting_partner_settlements_v1.reserved_amount) AS reserved,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text) AS pending_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS invalid_count
           FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
          GROUP BY reporting_partner_settlements_v1.partner_id
        ), quality AS (
         SELECT ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_capital_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_capital_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS capital_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_earnings_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_earnings_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_earnings_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date()) AS earnings_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE NOT reporting_partner_settlements_v1.valid OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Completed'::text AND (reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL OR reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date > olap_reporting_date())) AS settlement_exceptions,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM reporting_partner_settlements_v1
                  WHERE reporting_partner_settlements_v1.status = 'Pending'::text AND reporting_partner_settlements_v1.activity_date IS NULL) AS undated_pending,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(reporting_partner_capital_v1.net_movement), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM reporting_partner_capital_v1) AS pool,
            ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(olap_repayments_analytics."Partner A Profit" + olap_repayments_analytics."Partner B Profit" - olap_repayments_analytics."Interest Paid"::numeric), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                   FROM olap_repayments_analytics) AS allocation_residual
        ), amounts AS (
         SELECT p.partner_id,
            p.partner_name,
            p.partner_role,
            p.role_count,
            COALESCE(c.net_capital, 0::numeric) AS net_capital,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.interest_earned, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS interest_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN p.role_count = 1 AND q.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND q.capital_exceptions = 0 THEN COALESCE(e.expenses, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS expenses,
            COALESCE(s.completed, 0::numeric) AS completed,
            COALESCE(s.pending, 0::numeric) AS pending,
            COALESCE(s.reserved, 0::numeric) AS reserved,
            COALESCE(s.pending_count, 0::bigint) AS pending_count,
            q.capital_exceptions,
            q.earnings_exceptions,
            q.settlement_exceptions,
            q.undated_pending,
            q.pool,
            q.allocation_residual
           FROM partners p
             LEFT JOIN capital c USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN earnings e USING (partner_id)
             LEFT JOIN settlements s USING (partner_id)
             CROSS JOIN quality q
        ), final AS (
         SELECT a.partner_id,
            a.partner_name,
            a.partner_role,
            a.role_count,
            a.net_capital,
            a.interest_earned,
            a.expenses,
            a.completed,
            a.pending,
            a.reserved,
            a.pending_count,
            a.capital_exceptions,
            a.earnings_exceptions,
            a.settlement_exceptions,
            a.undated_pending,
            a.pool,
            a.allocation_residual,
            a.interest_earned - a.expenses AS net_earned,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.pool > 0::numeric AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM amounts
                      WHERE amounts.net_capital < 0::numeric)) THEN a.net_capital / a.pool
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS capital_share,
            a.role_count = 1 AND a.capital_exceptions = 0 AND a.earnings_exceptions = 0 AND a.settlement_exceptions = 0 AS ready
           FROM amounts a
        )
 SELECT partner_id,
    partner_name,
    partner_role,
    role_count,
    net_capital,
    interest_earned,
    expenses,
    completed,
    pending,
    reserved,
    pending_count,
    capital_exceptions,
    earnings_exceptions,
    settlement_exceptions,
    undated_pending,
    pool,
    allocation_residual,
    net_earned,
    capital_share,
    ready,
    net_earned - completed AS unpaid,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN net_earned - reserved
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS available,
    reserved - completed - pending AS other_reserved,
        CASE
            WHEN ready THEN 'Ready'::text
            ELSE 'Needs review'::text
        END AS quality_status,
    (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text) AS queried_at
   FROM final f;

relations.name: reporting_partner_settlements_v1
relations.definition:
SELECT s."Row ID" AS settlement_id,
    s."Ref Partner" AS partner_id,
    p."Partner Name" AS partner_name,
    p."Partner Role" AS partner_role,
    s."Transfer Date" AS activity_date,
    s."Amount"::numeric AS amount,
    s."Status" AS status,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Completed'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS completed_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" = 'Pending'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS pending_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Status" IS DISTINCT FROM 'Cancelled'::text THEN s."Amount"::numeric
            ELSE 0::numeric
        END AS reserved_amount,
    ((p."Partner Role" = ANY (ARRAY['A'::text, 'B'::text])) AND s."Amount" IS NOT NULL AND s."Amount"::numeric > 0::numeric AND (s."Status" = ANY (ARRAY['Completed'::text, 'Pending'::text, 'Cancelled'::text]))) IS TRUE AS valid,
        CASE
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" IS NULL THEN 'Date missing'::text
            WHEN s."Transfer Date" > olap_reporting_date() THEN 'Future transfer date'::text
            ELSE 'Dated'::text
        END AS date_status
   FROM "Settlements" s
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner";

relations.name: reporting_settlements
relations.definition:
SELECT s."Row ID" AS "Settlement ID",
    s."Ref Partner" AS "Partner ID",
    p."Partner Name" AS "Partner",
    p."Partner Role",
    s."Transfer Date",
    s."Amount"::numeric AS "Amount",
    s."Status"
   FROM "Settlements" s
     LEFT JOIN "Partners" p ON p."Row ID" = s."Ref Partner"
  WHERE s."Transfer Date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Bangkok'::text)::date;

relations.name: reporting_statement_calendar
relations.definition:
SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('month'::text, LEAST(( SELECT min(reporting_income_events."Date") AS min
           FROM reporting_income_events), ( SELECT min("Cash Ledger"."Movement Date") AS min
           FROM "Cash Ledger"), ( SELECT min(reporting_cash_scopes.available) AS min
           FROM reporting_cash_scopes), olap_reporting_date())::timestamp with time zone)::date::timestamp with time zone, olap_reporting_date()::timestamp with time zone, '1 day'::interval)::date AS "Date";
